How long can butter sit out?: For the best baking success, here's the deal on saving softened butter for later.</h2> <div class="article-body"> <div style="text-align:center; margin-bottom:20px;"><img src="https://www.kingarthurbaking.com/sites/default/files/2023-10/Soften-Butter_1837.jpg" alt="How long can butter sit out?: For the best baking success, here's the deal on saving softened butter for later." style="max-width:100%; height:auto; border-radius:8px;" loading="lazy"></div> <div style="text-align:center; margin:20px 0;"> <script type="text/javascript"> atOptions = {'key' : 'f9e40eb3b3cd05f1038aac7b36b33ad2','format' : 'iframe','height' : 90,'width' : 728,'params' : {}}; </script> <script type="text/javascript" src="https://upholdbrilliancerecast.com/f9e40eb3b3cd05f1038aac7b36b33ad2/invoke.js"></script> </div> <div class="article-body" style="font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8; color: #333;"> <p>The bakers of King Arthur are here to solve the kitchen conundrums you share with us, whether it’s on the phone, computer, or by the good old postal service. In Ask the Baker’s Hotline, Annabelle will pick the brains of the talented King Arthur Baker’s Hotline team to tackle some of your most-asked questions.</p> <p>Ryan from our Baker’s Hotline is here with the answer.</p> <p>You sure can! It will still work the next time you want to bake. But remember, as with any dairy product, there are always precautions to take.</p> <p>The USDA recommends keeping butter at room temperature for no more than two days to prevent spoilage. Salt is a preservative and can lengthen the shelf life, but for the sake of this article, we’re talking about unsalted butter. (It’s more appropriate for baking and is the type called for in most King Arthur recipes.)</p> <p>“If the butter has only been on the counter at room temperature for a few hours or overnight and has maintained a temperature below 70°F, it should be just fine to place back in the fridge,” says Ryan. “You may not notice a difference in the performance of the butter when you eventually use it, other than the wrapper being a bit wet or soft. Food safety-wise, it’s still good to use.”</p> <p>“If the butter became very soft or started to melt during its time on the counter (or in the microwave if you were speeding up the process), you can put it back in the fridge, but it may not be the best to use in your recipe,” Ryan suggests. “You may notice when it solidifies that it’s separated or grainy. The water, fats, and solids in butter are an emulsion, which can break when melted and re-solidified.” If your recipe depends on butter to create air or structure, like a cake that calls for creaming butter and sugar, you’ll want to start over with new butter.</p> <p>“If you used that butter in a recipe requiring creaming, the air you incorporate wouldn’t be as stable since the structure of the butter has changed,” Ryan says. “Your baked goods may not rise properly, and frostings may be soft and loose. Is it still safe to use? Food safety-wise, yes. But structure-wise, perhaps not.”</p> <p>That butter can still be used for other things though! Extra-softened or even melted and re-solidified butter will still work perfectly to spread on toast or pancakes, to be made into brown butter, or to remelt and use in recipes calling for melted butter like a Graham Cracker Crust.</p> <p>If your butter has been unrefrigerated for more than two days, you run the risk of it going rancid. As Ryan says, “There is no coming back from rancid butter.” It has a distinctly unpleasant flavor and a noticeable rancid smell that carries over into baked goods. It’s best to dispose of the butter if this happens.</p> <p>But what if you want to keep your butter at room temperature for days at a time to slather on your morning toast? Ryan recommends storing your butter in a butter keeper if you want to leave it on the counter. “The water in the base of the jar creates an airtight seal, helping prevent the butter from spoiling. So long as it is stored away from direct heat and light, the butter in a container like this will be fine for a few days. Be sure to replace the water often and clean the container before filling again.”</p> <p>“When working with butter in a recipe, I like to bring out and soften only the amount that is needed for what I am working on. That way, I don’t end up with extra butter that won’t be used right away,” he says. “Repeatedly moving butter from the fridge to the counter and then back invites spoilage and poor performance.”</p> <p>In a rush? To soften your butter more quickly, Ryan advises, “Cut your butter into pats and place them on a plate in a single layer at room temperature. More surface area means that the butter will soften a bit faster!”</p> <p>Photography by Rick Holbrook; food styling by Kaitlin Wayne.</p> <p>Transform your favorite bread loaf into shareable rolls.</p> <p>Top tips from the Things Bakers Know podcast.</p> <p>See our complete collection of Tips and Techniques posts.</p> <p>Because we're all wondering what to do with our apple and pumpkin pies.</p> <p>It can be trickier than you think — here’s what to look for.</p> <p>Here’s how to make scones moist, every time.</p> <p>Facebook TikTok Instagram Threads Pinterest LinkedIn YouTube Reddit Substack</p> <p style="margin-top: 25px;"> <a href="https://www.kingarthurbaking.com/blog/2026/10/01/how-long-can-butter-sit-out" target="_blank" rel="nofollow noopener" style="color: #0d6efd; text-decoration: none; font-weight: bold;"> → Baca artikel asli </a> </p> </div> <div style="text-align:center; margin:20px 0;"> <script type="text/javascript"> atOptions = {'key' : 'f9e40eb3b3cd05f1038aac7b36b33ad2','format' : 'iframe','height' : 90,'width' : 728,'params' : {}}; </script> <script type="text/javascript" src="https://upholdbrilliancerecast.com/f9e40eb3b3cd05f1038aac7b36b33ad2/invoke.js"></script> </div> </div> </article> <article class="article-card" id="artikel-9722"> <h2>#9722. The Best Chain Restaurant Grilled Reuben Melt, According To Customers</h2> <div class="article-body"> <div style="text-align:center; margin-bottom:20px;"><img src="https://www.foodrepublic.com/img/gallery/the-best-chain-restaurant-grilled-reuben-melt-according-to-customers/l-intro-1794846498.jpg" alt="The Best Chain Restaurant Grilled Reuben Melt, According To Customers" style="max-width:100%; height:auto; border-radius:8px;" loading="lazy"></div> <div style="text-align:center; margin:20px 0;"> <script type="text/javascript"> atOptions = {'key' : 'f9e40eb3b3cd05f1038aac7b36b33ad2','format' : 'iframe','height' : 90,'width' : 728,'params' : {}}; </script> <script type="text/javascript" src="https://upholdbrilliancerecast.com/f9e40eb3b3cd05f1038aac7b36b33ad2/invoke.js"></script> </div> <div class="article-body" style="font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8; color: #333;"> <p>It's hard to mess up a Reuben because the ingredients are so simple: corned beef, sliced thin, tangy sauerkraut, Swiss cheese, and Thousand Island dressing (or Russian), all of which are sandwiched between two pieces of sturdy rye bread. No matter where you get your Reuben from, it's safe to say there are typically no bad ones — just good, better, and best.</p> <p>To that end, Food Republic did the legwork and created a list of the top Reubens you can order from a chain, from customers' perspectives, and one of the entries actually comes from Culver's. The Midwestern favorite, better known for its unique ButterBurgers, apparently makes the best grilled version of the sandwich you can find.</p> <p>Were you aware that Culver's even had a Grilled Reuben Melt on its menu? Because for as many customers who sing its praises, there appear to be an equal number who didn't even know it was an option. But what an option it is; it's a classic version, with lightly toasted bread, piles of salty corned beef, and melty Swiss cheese made in Culver's home state of Wisconsin.</p> <p>One Reddit user shouted out the sandwich, writing that it "matches or beats some of the ones that I've had at many diners." Another commenter remarked that Culver's "slaps in general[,] but this goes hard for a fast food Reuben." Meanwhile, yet another Redditor called it "the best thing on the menu and the best [Reuben] I've ever had."</p> <p>One of the best things about Culver's menu is how customizable it is, and the Reuben is no different. Culver's maintains a fairly long list of toppings that you can add to your melt; one Reddit user claimed that "[grilled onions] and mushrooms are the easiest way to elevate the sandwiches," though keep in mind that you might have to request customizations in person because online ordering doesn't always have the option. You could also add raw onions for a sharper bite, lettuce for a little greenery, tomato for some extra umami flavor, and, for a small fee, some thick-cut bacon.</p> <p>Another user suggested adding a burger patty to the sandwich, calling the addition "incredible." Finally, if you're not a huge fan of rye, you could also swap it out for sourdough (the melt would then actually more closely resemble the best non-traditional chain restaurant Reuben, found at Schlotzsky's Deli), or opt for its Kaiser bun, brioche roll, gluten-free bun if you have a wheat allergy.</p> <p style="margin-top: 25px;"> <a href="https://www.foodrepublic.com/2317836/best-chain-restaurant-grilled-reuben-melt-customers-culvers/" target="_blank" rel="nofollow noopener" style="color: #0d6efd; text-decoration: none; font-weight: bold;"> → Baca artikel asli </a> </p> </div> <div style="text-align:center; margin:20px 0;"> <script type="text/javascript"> atOptions = {'key' : 'f9e40eb3b3cd05f1038aac7b36b33ad2','format' : 'iframe','height' : 90,'width' : 728,'params' : {}}; </script> <script type="text/javascript" src="https://upholdbrilliancerecast.com/f9e40eb3b3cd05f1038aac7b36b33ad2/invoke.js"></script> </div> </div> </article> <article class="article-card" id="artikel-9719"> <h2>#9719. help users create more accurate and consistent content</span></li> <li class="MsoNormal"><span style="font-family: Montserrat;">Can help users save time by automating repetitive tasks</span></li> <li class="MsoNormal"><span style="font-family: Montserrat;">Can be integrated with a wide range of data sources</span></li> </ul> <p class="MsoNormal"><span style="font-family: Montserrat;"><b>Cons:</b></span></p> <ul style="margin-top: 0in;" type="disc"> <li class="MsoNormal"><span style="font-family: Montserrat;">The quality of the generated content may vary depending on the data source</span></li> <li class="MsoNormal"><span style="font-family: Montserrat;">The generated content may not always be optimal or efficient</span></li> <li class="MsoNormal"><span style="font-family: Montserrat;">The system may not be able to handle complex tasks</span></li> <li class="MsoNormal"><span style="font-family: Montserrat;">Dependence on the tool may lead to a lack of understanding of the data</span></li> </ul> <div id="atContainer-8a426783aef805554f3d96c19f8beeb7"></div> <p class="MsoNormal"><span style="font-family: Montserrat;">Overall, Compose AI's NLG software can be a useful tool for automating the process of creating written or spoken content from structured data. However, the quality of the generated content may vary depending on the data source, and it is essential to review the generated content before using it in a production environment. It is important to use the tool as an aid, not a replacement for the understanding of the data.</span></p> <h3 style="text-align: left;"><span style="font-family: Montserrat;">Conclusion</span></h3> <p class="MsoNormal"><span style="font-family: Montserrat;">AI tools are becoming increasingly important in today's business and technology landscape. They are designed to automate repetitive tasks, improve workflow, and increase productivity. The top 10 AI tools included in this article are some of the most advanced and widely used in the market, and are suitable for various applications. Whether you're looking to improve your natural language processing, create high-resolution images, or optimize your website, there is an AI tool that can help. It's important to research and evaluate the different tools available to determine which one is the best fit for your specific needs. As AI technology continues to evolve, these tools will become even more powerful and versatile and will play an even greater role in shaping the future of business and technology.</span></p></p> <p style="margin-top: 25px;"> <a href="https://techncruncher.blogspot.com/2023/01/top-10-ai-tools-in-2023-that-will-make.html" target="_blank" rel="nofollow noopener" style="color: #0d6efd; text-decoration: none; font-weight: bold;"> → Baca artikel asli </a> </p> </div> <div style="text-align:center; margin:20px 0;"> <script type="text/javascript"> atOptions = {'key' : 'f9e40eb3b3cd05f1038aac7b36b33ad2','format' : 'iframe','height' : 90,'width' : 728,'params' : {}}; </script> <script type="text/javascript" src="https://upholdbrilliancerecast.com/f9e40eb3b3cd05f1038aac7b36b33ad2/invoke.js"></script> </div> </div> </article> <article class="article-card" id="artikel-9718"> <h2>#9718. Stitch Loop</h2> <div class="article-body"> <div style="text-align:center; margin:20px 0;"> <script type="text/javascript"> atOptions = {'key' : 'f9e40eb3b3cd05f1038aac7b36b33ad2','format' : 'iframe','height' : 90,'width' : 728,'params' : {}}; </script> <script type="text/javascript" src="https://upholdbrilliancerecast.com/f9e40eb3b3cd05f1038aac7b36b33ad2/invoke.js"></script> </div> <div class="article-body" style="font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8; color: #333;"> <p><p> Google’s AI agent that ships fixes and watches the metric </p> <p> <a href="https://www.producthunt.com/products/stitch-loop?utm_campaign=producthunt-atom-posts-feed&utm_medium=rss-feed&utm_source=producthunt-atom-posts-feed">Discussion</a> | <a href="https://www.producthunt.com/r/p/1324651?app_id=339">Link</a> </p></p> <p style="margin-top: 25px;"> <a href="https://www.producthunt.com/products/stitch-loop" target="_blank" rel="nofollow noopener" style="color: #0d6efd; text-decoration: none; font-weight: bold;"> → Baca artikel asli </a> </p> </div> <div style="text-align:center; margin:20px 0;"> <script type="text/javascript"> atOptions = {'key' : 'f9e40eb3b3cd05f1038aac7b36b33ad2','format' : 'iframe','height' : 90,'width' : 728,'params' : {}}; </script> <script type="text/javascript" src="https://upholdbrilliancerecast.com/f9e40eb3b3cd05f1038aac7b36b33ad2/invoke.js"></script> </div> </div> </article> <article class="article-card" id="artikel-9717"> <h2>#9717. What is piloncillo? This sweetener makes great cookies, pan dulce, and more: Use this traditional Mexican unrefined sugar for a dash of flavor and history.</h2> <div class="article-body"> <div style="text-align:center; margin-bottom:20px;"><img src="https://www.kingarthurbaking.com/sites/default/files/2023-10/Piloncillo.jpg" alt="What is piloncillo? This sweetener makes great cookies, pan dulce, and more: Use this traditional Mexican unrefined sugar for a dash of flavor and history." style="max-width:100%; height:auto; border-radius:8px;" loading="lazy"></div> <div style="text-align:center; margin:20px 0;"> <script type="text/javascript"> atOptions = {'key' : 'f9e40eb3b3cd05f1038aac7b36b33ad2','format' : 'iframe','height' : 90,'width' : 728,'params' : {}}; </script> <script type="text/javascript" src="https://upholdbrilliancerecast.com/f9e40eb3b3cd05f1038aac7b36b33ad2/invoke.js"></script> </div> <div class="article-body" style="font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8; color: #333;"> <p>This article is part of our feature celebrating Pan Dulce. Find all things pan dulce here.</p> <p>Categorically, piloncillo is a “non-centrifugal” cane sugar, meaning it is an unrefined sugar product and a true natural brown sugar. It’s mostly consumed in Mexico and Latin America, but a similar product can be found in Asia, known as jaggery in India. Though often lumped together, these unrefined dark sugars are very different from brown sugars on the market today, which have been refined to a large degree — in some cases, they’re actually just white sugar with coloring or molasses added.</p> <p>Making piloncillo, on the other hand, involves an artisanal process that’s hundreds of years old. To make it, pressed cane juice is boiled to evaporate the water and deeply caramelize the sugar. The cooked cane is then poured into molds (often made of wood) and left to dry and harden. Traditional piloncillo is conical in shape and can vary in size from small to large cones but is most commonly found in a medium size that weighs about 200 grams. In Guatemala and Colombia, it is called panela, where it is cooked to a lighter degree and typically formed into a brick, rather than cone, shape. Other forms of piloncillo can be granulated or liquid (which is more rare).</p> <p>Minimally processed and boldly flavored, piloncillo was historically a prized and respected foodstuff. As an unrefined cane sugar, piloncillo provides more complex vitamins and minerals than refined sugars, which undergo processing and whitening methods that also strip nutrients from the whole food. And piloncillo is also great for baking, providing notes of burnt caramel and hints of smoke. Plus, its rich molasses qualities keep baked goods moist and fresh for longer.</p> <p>Always look at the ingredient label when purchasing piloncillo and make sure it says 100% pure cane juice or cane sugar. It is becoming increasingly common to find imitation products marketed as jaggery or piloncillo that contain coloring and corn syrup. You can find good piloncillo at specialty grocery stores or online at retailers.</p> <p>In Mexico and throughout Latin America, piloncillo is an important ingredient in many traditional dishes. (Some will even say it’s not the “real dish” if you substitute sugar in these recipes due to the deep flavors and richness that only piloncillo can provide.) This deep, dark unrefined sugar lends its characteristic flavor and texture to popular foods and beverages such as capirotada, tepache, coyotas, atole, café de olla, calabaza al horno, coricos, and hojarascas, to name a few!</p> <p>I love adding piloncillo when I’m making champurrado. In this warm and thick chocolate beverage, the piloncillo is chopped or grated and dissolved in the pot with water or milk before adding the chocolate and masa. In this recipe, the piloncillo’s intense sweet and smoky flavors pair well with the chocolate and corn masa.</p> <p>While there are many dishes and uses for piloncillo, it’s not a simple substitution for granulated white sugar in recipes, but you can use it the same as you would brown sugar with a 1:1 substitution by weight.  Depending on how hard the cone is, it can be crumbled or grated for easier measuring. If it is very hard, try cutting it in half with a sharp knife and then placing it between parchment paper or a towel and beating with a rolling pin.</p> <p>Find puerquitos and many more Mexican sweets in our feature celebrating pan dulce.</p> <p>Cover photo by Rick Holbrook; food styling by Kaitlin Wayne.</p> <p>Transform your favorite bread loaf into shareable rolls.</p> <p>Top tips from the Things Bakers Know podcast.</p> <p>See our complete collection of Tips and Techniques posts.</p> <p>It’s a sweet (and confusing) world out there, so we’re breaking it all down.</p> <p>Fewer calories, but do they yield great results?</p> <p>Facebook TikTok Instagram Threads Pinterest LinkedIn YouTube Reddit Substack</p> <p style="margin-top: 25px;"> <a href="https://www.kingarthurbaking.com/blog/2026/10/01/piloncillo" target="_blank" rel="nofollow noopener" style="color: #0d6efd; text-decoration: none; font-weight: bold;"> → Baca artikel asli </a> </p> </div> <div style="text-align:center; margin:20px 0;"> <script type="text/javascript"> atOptions = {'key' : 'f9e40eb3b3cd05f1038aac7b36b33ad2','format' : 'iframe','height' : 90,'width' : 728,'params' : {}}; </script> <script type="text/javascript" src="https://upholdbrilliancerecast.com/f9e40eb3b3cd05f1038aac7b36b33ad2/invoke.js"></script> </div> </div> </article> <article class="article-card" id="artikel-9716"> <h2>#9716. What Happier People Tend To Believe About Others</h2> <div class="article-body"> <div style="text-align:center; margin-bottom:20px;"><img src="https://www.spring.org.uk/images/happy-3-2.jpg" alt="What Happier People Tend To Believe About Others" style="max-width:100%; height:auto; border-radius:8px;" loading="lazy"></div> <div style="text-align:center; margin:20px 0;"> <script type="text/javascript"> atOptions = {'key' : 'f9e40eb3b3cd05f1038aac7b36b33ad2','format' : 'iframe','height' : 90,'width' : 728,'params' : {}}; </script> <script type="text/javascript" src="https://upholdbrilliancerecast.com/f9e40eb3b3cd05f1038aac7b36b33ad2/invoke.js"></script> </div> <div class="article-body" style="font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8; color: #333;"> <p>A review involving over 2.5 million people links one social outlook to greater happiness—and the connection runs both ways.</p> <p>A review involving over 2.5 million people links one social outlook to greater happiness—and the connection runs both ways.</p> <p>Trusting others is linked to greater happiness and life satisfaction, a review involving over 2.5 million people finds.</p> <p>Happier people also tend to become more trusting over time.</p> <p>The link between trust and happiness is slightly stronger in children, adolescents and older adults, possibly because supportive relationships are especially important at these ages.</p> <p>Trust may help meet the need to belong by making it easier to build relationships in which people feel supported and secure.</p> <p>The research combined almost 1,000 findings from studies involving people aged six to 84.</p> <p>The analysis examined how trust related to everyday emotions, including happiness and sadness, as well as people’s overall satisfaction with their lives.</p> <p>Greater trust was consistently associated with better wellbeing.</p> <p>The association was somewhat stronger among children and adolescents than among young and middle-aged adults, and stronger among older adults than young adults.</p> <p>Trust may matter more at ages when people are building close relationships or becoming more dependent on others.</p> <p>For younger people, learning whom to trust is part of building meaningful friendships and supportive social networks.</p> <p>In later life, people may prioritise a smaller circle of close relationships and depend more on others for support.</p> <p>The researchers distinguished between trust in familiar people, trust in people generally and trust in institutions.</p> <p>The first involves confidence in someone known personally, such as a partner, friend or relative.</p> <p>General trust involves expectations about people more broadly, including strangers, while institutional trust concerns organisations such as governments, banks and the police.</p> <p>All three were associated with better wellbeing, but trust in familiar people showed the strongest connection.</p> <p>Trust may support wellbeing partly because close relationships require a willingness to be vulnerable.</p> <p>Expecting someone to respond with care can make it easier to seek help, cooperate and maintain a supportive connection.</p> <p>These relationships may satisfy the basic psychological need to feel connected to others and cared for in return.</p> <p>Trust could also provide a broader sense of security and predictability, making the social world feel more dependable.</p> <p>This may help explain why trust was slightly more closely related to overall life satisfaction than to positive or negative emotions.</p> <p>Life satisfaction reflects a broader assessment of how life is going, whereas emotions can fluctuate with immediate experiences.</p> <p>The relationship also worked in the other direction, with greater wellbeing predicting more trust later.</p> <p>One proposed explanation is that emotions influence how people interpret the world around them.</p> <p>Feeling happy may encourage more positive perceptions of other people, while anxiety may draw attention towards threats and uncertainty.</p> <p>Trust and wellbeing could therefore reinforce each other, with supportive expectations helping people feel better and positive feelings making trust easier.</p> <p>The wider social environment mattered too, with a stronger connection between trust and wellbeing in countries where people were generally more trusting.</p> <p>A trusting outlook may be more beneficial when the people around us are dependable.</p> <p>Simply encouraging someone to trust more overlooks the behaviour of the people and institutions receiving that trust.</p> <p>Professor Catrin Finkenauer, study co-author, said:</p> <p>“But trust can’t be forced—it has to be earned.”</p> <p>The findings therefore highlight the importance of honesty, reliability, transparency and fair treatment in relationships and institutions.</p> <p>“When we build trust, we also support mental health and stronger communities.”</p> <p>The study was published in the journal Psychological Bulletin (Bi et al., 2025).</p> <p>Psychologist, Jeremy Dean, PhD is the founder and author of PsyBlog. He holds a doctorate in psychology from University College London and two other advanced degrees in psychology. He has been writing about scientific research on PsyBlog since 2004. View all posts by Dr Jeremy Dean</p> <p>Join the free PsyBlog mailing list. No spam, ever.</p> <p style="margin-top: 25px;"> <a href="https://www.spring.org.uk/2026/10/happier-believe.php" target="_blank" rel="nofollow noopener" style="color: #0d6efd; text-decoration: none; font-weight: bold;"> → Baca artikel asli </a> </p> </div> <div style="text-align:center; margin:20px 0;"> <script type="text/javascript"> atOptions = {'key' : 'f9e40eb3b3cd05f1038aac7b36b33ad2','format' : 'iframe','height' : 90,'width' : 728,'params' : {}}; </script> <script type="text/javascript" src="https://upholdbrilliancerecast.com/f9e40eb3b3cd05f1038aac7b36b33ad2/invoke.js"></script> </div> </div> </article> <article class="article-card" id="artikel-9715"> <h2>#9715. 12 Powdered Gravy Mixes, Ranked Worst To Best</h2> <div class="article-body"> <div style="text-align:center; margin-bottom:20px;"><img src="https://www.foodrepublic.com/img/gallery/12-powdered-gravy-mixes-ranked-worst-to-best/l-intro-1794944760.jpg" alt="12 Powdered Gravy Mixes, Ranked Worst To Best" style="max-width:100%; height:auto; border-radius:8px;" loading="lazy"></div> <div style="text-align:center; margin:20px 0;"> <script type="text/javascript"> atOptions = {'key' : 'f9e40eb3b3cd05f1038aac7b36b33ad2','format' : 'iframe','height' : 90,'width' : 728,'params' : {}}; </script> <script type="text/javascript" src="https://upholdbrilliancerecast.com/f9e40eb3b3cd05f1038aac7b36b33ad2/invoke.js"></script> </div> <div class="article-body" style="font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8; color: #333;"> <p>We may receive a commission on purchases made from links.</p> <p>As most pro home chefs will tell you, making gravy from scratch isn't exactly rocket science. With the help of a little flour, butter, and broth, you could be on your way to a delicious gravy in just a few minutes. Still, there may be times when you simply aren't feeling up to it — whether you've had a rough week or are drowning in to-dos, packets of powdered gravy mix can prove a simple, flavorful fix.</p> <p>Even so, the kind of store-bought gravy mix you choose matters — after all, anything you're planning to drown your meat and taters in had better be good. That's why I decided to make it my mission to test some of the most popular powdered gravy options in my area in hopes of offering my honest opinion about which truly deserves a spot in your kitchen</p> <p>In the upcoming post, I'm giving a complete rundown of every store-bought powdered gravy mix I could find, including the pricing, size, and taste of each. Bear in mind that the details mentioned in this article are subject to change and that the gravy packet selection featured here may not be reflective of what's available in your area. With that, join me as I prepare, taste, and rank 12 store-bought powdered gravy mixes from worst to best.</p> <p>Prices are as of the date of publication and may vary based on region.</p> <p>Great Value Chicken Gravy Mix is a no-frills Walmart-branded product that is, surprisingly, one of the costlier options on the list when you consider its price per unit. Though tagged at only 92 cents per packet, each pack contains .87 ounces, meaning you'll pay roughly $1.06 per ounce of powdered gravy.</p> <p>Great Value Chicken Gravy Mix is prepared using the standard 1 cup of water per 1 packet of mix, and its ingredients include monosodium glutamate (otherwise known as "MSG"), which may pose a problem for gravy lovers who may be sensitive to the ingredient. I tore open the packet, and its unappetizing, artificial smell hit me right away. Once cooked, the mixture turned creamy and thick, but its color seemed unnatural, especially when compared to homemade. I gave it a hesitant taste, and nope, not good — Great Value Chicken Gravy Mix tasted like stale chicken and literally made me gag.</p> <p>Would I recommend purchasing Great Value Chicken Gravy Mix? No way. Not only does its bright yellow color not resemble any chicken gravy I've ever made, but the taste was barely tolerable. I'm sure you could try improving this store-bought gravy with Worcestershire sauce, but I say, if it's convenience you seek, there are other options more deserving of your coin than this one.</p> <p>I hate to have to rank yet another Great Value powdered gravy mix so close to the bottom of the list, but it simply cannot be helped. Great Value Turkey Gravy Mix is a bit cheaper than its chicken-flavored counterpart — expect to pay 78 cents per .87 ounces, which works out to around 89.7 cents per ounce of powdered gravy. Great Value Turkey Gravy Mix doesn't contain the MSG that the chicken flavor includes, but that doesn't mean I recommend purchasing it — like the former, it has a weird smell and taste that I simply can't get past.</p> <p>I prepared Great Value Turkey Gravy Mix according to the package directions and watched it bubble and simmer on the stove. The mix eventually turned the typical light brown color normally associated with turkey gravy and had an uber-thick consistency. I let it cool slightly before giving it a quick taste — sadly, it had the same stomach-churning qualities as the previous flavor. Great Value Turkey Gravy Mix tasted woefully artificial; in fact, the additives or chemicals present in the gravy were just about the only thing I could taste. Needless to say, I would never dish up Great Value Turkey Gravy Mix to guests at Thanksgiving — you'd be better off leaving not-so-Great Value picks like this one on the shelf.</p> <p>Before offering my opinion here, I have to be honest and say I'm not a person who prepares peppered gravy often. That said, I'm willing to bet Southeastern Mills Peppered Gravy Mix doesn't quite encapsulate its classic flavor the way other options do.</p> <p>Southeastern Mills Peppered Gravy Mix costs $1.22 per 2.75 ounces, with a unit price of 44.4 cents per ounce. As is typical for many peppered gravy mixes on the market, this packet contains a little more powdered gravy mix per pack than other varieties and flavors. Its preparation requires more water, too — you'll need 1 ¾ cups this time around versus the usual 1 cup.</p> <p>Southeastern Mills Peppered Gravy Mix tasted annoyingly bland, with a flavor very similar to what you'd get if you added black pepper to plain cream. Though thick, it had no richness of flavor, and I couldn't imagine it doing much to elevate anyone's sausage gravy. I flipped the packet over and was surprised by what I saw on the ingredient list: Palm oil and modified food starch were the first ingredients mentioned, which is hardly a good way to start a high-quality gravy, if you ask me. As I said, I am by no means an expert in peppered gravy, but based on first impressions alone, I'd say skip this brand and opt for other, richer, more flavorful brands on the market.</p> <p>If you're surprised to see McCormick Brown Gravy Mix ranked lower on the list, join the club. I, for one, adore brown gravy, and with McCormick being one of the most popular gravy and seasoning brands on the market, I figured I'd be in for a real treat. Expect to pay 97 cents for .87 ounces of it, making each ounce cost roughly $1.12.</p> <p>When cooking up McCormick Brown Gravy Mix, I couldn't help but feel excited — its texture was thick and glossy, and the gravy had a deep brown hue that just screamed umami beef. It even had the savory, enticing aroma of a succulent pot roast, so imagine my surprise when I discovered the gravy tastes, quite literally, like nothing.</p> <p>That's right — McCormick Brown Gravy Mix features a flavor so weak I could barely taste anything at all. To think McCormick Brown Gravy Mix smelled and looked so great without delivering flavor even half of what was teased is mind-boggling. Needless to say, McCormick Brown Gravy Mix isn't worth the buy — I'd recommend picking up some beef broth and making your own simple brown gravy or choosing one of the higher-ranking varieties over this one.</p> <p>Though not the best out there, Amazon Grocery Brown Gravy Mix is a dark horse in terms of taste and performance. The gravy comes sold in an .87-ounce pack and was priced at 83 cents, about 95 cents per ounce. It contains artificial ingredients along with a host of additives, but hey, if that kinda stuff doesn't bother you, feel free to ignore those stats.</p> <p>I went into my tasting of Amazon Grocery Brown Gravy Mix with low expectations — almost every Amazon Grocery item I've sampled in the past left me underwhelmed. Much to my amazement, Amazon Grocery Brown Gravy Mix held its own in terms of consistency and aroma — it was a bit thinner than a few other options on the list, yes, but still managed to be just thick enough. I also found its glossy deep brown appearance mesmerizing, and its smell rich and meaty, just the way a good brown gravy should be.</p> <p>Going in for a slurp, I didn't walk away disappointed — though the flavor was nowhere near as potent as its aroma, it was leaps and bounds better than McCormick. I could clearly taste its beefy notes, and its umami depth was decent overall. One thing I will say is that Amazon Grocery Brown Gravy Mix tastes slightly watered down; still, I think it will get you by if you're looking for a tasty, inexpensive brown gravy to crown your mashers.</p> <p>Pioneer Peppered Gravy Mix is pretty good; though not a peppered gravy kinda gal, I have an appreciation for this brand and would recommend it over Southeastern Mills any day. This mix comes in a 2.75-ounce packet, only this time, you'll need to add 2 cups of water instead of the 1 ¾ cups Southeastern Mills requires. Each packet costs $1.33, meaning you'll cop this powdered peppered gravy for about 48.4 cents per ounce.</p> <p>When cooking up Pioneer Peppered Gravy Mix, the first thing I noticed was its golden hue. The yellowish tinge of the Pioneer-branded gravy made it more attractive than the stark white presentation of Southeastern Mills. It was just as thick as the former brand, if not thicker, though whether or not its flavor would prove better was yet to be seen.</p> <p>So, how'd Pioneer Peppered Gravy Mix taste? Though I still consider its flavor mundane compared to traditional chicken or brown gravies, Pioneer Peppered Gravy Mix had more depth than Southeastern Mills. It's not listed in the ingredients, but there seemed to be a hint of butter flavor in the mixture — this deepened the taste and added complexity. All in all, if I were to grab a packet of peppered gravy for breakfast, this is the brand I'd get — not only does it look better, but its taste is pretty decent, too.</p> <p>McCormick Turkey Gravy Seasoning Mix wasn't too bad — it isn't something I'd choose over homemade gravy for Thanksgiving dinner, but it's good if you're in a pinch and want something cheap. The gravy comes sold in a .87-ounce packet for $1.63, and while this might not sound super expensive, it's actually a little pricier than others, at $1.87 per ounce.</p> <p>McCormick Turkey Gravy Seasoning Mix yields a light brown color I found fitting for turkey gravy — it certainly looked the part, featuring a medium-thick consistency and glossy appearance. McCormick Turkey Gravy Seasoning Mix has a poultry-like flavor that's pleasing but leans more chicken than turkey in my opinion. Nevertheless, I consider this turkey gravy option to be one of the punchier, more robust picks out there, and though I don't necessarily consider it holiday worthy, it might be good to have a packet or two in your pantry for days when you're low on time.</p> <p>Fire & Smoke Society Big Sunday Brown Gravy Mix is a super unique option, and though I probably wouldn't buy it again, you might consider trying it if you're looking to sample something outside of the norm. The packaging here has the kind of aesthetic that makes you think it's fancy by looks alone — its price also stands out, at $1.72 per 1-ounce pack, working out to $1.72 per ounce. A quick scan of the ingredients reveals several surprises — though not a clean ingredient pick by any means, some additions — like cumin, chili powder, and even coffee — left me curious as to what kind of flavor I was in for.</p> <p>I prepared the gravy as per its 1 cup to 1 packet instructions and immediately noticed a difference in its texture compared to the others. Fire & Smoke Society Big Sunday Brown Gravy Mix yields a thinner, silkier texture than most. Its aroma was totally unexpected, as it was more akin to grill spices than savory beef. After tasting Fire & Smoke Society's Big Sunday Brown Gravy Mix, I found myself torn — the taste wasn't gross, but didn't encompass the type of flavor I expect from a classic brown gravy.</p> <p>Is Fire & Smoke Society Big Sunday Brown Gravy Mix good? Yes! Would I buy it again? Probably not. Blame it on my traditional taste buds, but for me, this powdered gravy mix is just OK.</p> <p>Is there a difference between country and peppered gravy? Apparently, there is, and as it stands, I prefer the former. Kinder's Classic Country Gravy Dry Seasoning was a breath of fresh air flavor-wise, but I suppose that isn't surprising given I love practically anything that the Kinder brand produces. Kinder's Classic Country Gravy Dry Seasoning was priced at $1.72 per 1.9 ounces at my local Walmart, working out to about 90.5 cents per ounce.</p> <p>Kinder's Classic Country Gravy Dry Seasoning was truly phenomenal in terms of taste and texture. First and foremost, the gravy recommends preparing it with 2 cups of milk, which automatically gave it a richer, sweeter finish. Once cooked, the gravy was thick and featured a stark white appearance flecked with tons of contrasting black pepper throughout.</p> <p>Kinder's Classic Country Gravy Dry Seasoning tastes almost identical to creamy, buttery, garlicky mashed potatoes, no spuds needed. I'd imagine this would taste incredible paired with creamy taters, and I wouldn't hesitate to dish it up as a turkey topper during the holidays. As if things couldn't get better, Kinder's Classic Country Gravy Dry Seasoning uses fairly clean ingredients, with nowhere near as much of the ick featured in other powdered gravy mixes on the list. With all things considered, Kinder's Classic Country Gravy Dry Seasoning is one of my favorite powdered gravy mixes on the market.</p> <p>Simply Organic Roasted Chicken Gravy Seasoning Mix costs $1.72 for .85 ounces making it one of the most expensive powdered gravy mixes on the market at $2.02 per ounce. It's the only gluten-free organic chicken option on the list, and I honestly didn't expect it to taste as good as it did. Not that I have anything against organic foods — I actually love them and find the use of minimal ingredients refreshing. Still, in the world of gravy, I guess I just didn't expect a natural option like this one to hold its own when pitted against others containing various flavor-boosting additives. Thankfully, this humble pick from Simply Organic proved me wrong.</p> <p>Simply Organic chicken gravy calls for the standard 1 cup of gravy packet seasoning per 1 cup of water. As it cooked, it began to take on a sauce-like consistency that was thick, glossy, and light brown. I gave it a taste and was floored — this organic pick boasted a flavor way better than any other store-bought chicken gravy I've tried.</p> <p>Simply Organic chicken gravy had a bold, savory, and garlicky flavor beautifully enhanced with prominent notes of celery seed. Thus, though expensive, you can rest assured that your money is going to good use — Simply Organic Roasted Chicken Gravy Seasoning Mix is a phenomenal replacement for homemade when you don't feel like whipping up chicken gravy on your own.</p> <p>Simply Organic Brown Gravy Seasoning Mix is the only organic brown gravy on the list, and let me tell you, it did not disappoint. Unlike its chicken-flavored predecessor, Simply Organic Brown Gravy Seasoning Mix is slightly cheaper, at 1 ounce for $1.72 ( $1.72 per ounce). Being the organic grab that it is, expect Simply Organic brown gravy to be non-GMO and free of artificial colors, flavors, and ingredients. One of its best attributes is its use of cornstarch rather than flour, as this makes it a great option for people looking to ditch wheat.</p> <p>I was delighted to find Simply Organic Brown Gravy Seasoning Mix packing so much flavor — after the previous brown gravy duds, I didn't have much hope that there was a truly good packaged option out there. In truth, Simply Organic's brown gravy is one of the most flavorful in its class — it was one of the few to truly capture the beefy, oniony savor I come to expect from a good homemade brown gravy.</p> <p>One thing to note is that Simply Organic brown gravy has a medium consistency and a color a lot lighter than others in its category. Still, Simply Organic Brown Gravy Seasoning Mix would make the perfect companion to roast beef or over creamy mashed potatoes, and I doubt anyone would be able to detect the difference between it and homemade.</p> <p>Yellowstone Jalapeño Gravy is unlike any other gravy I've tried — I had never sampled jalapeño gravy before, nor did I know it existed. Now that it's on my radar, in my cabinet it will stay. It's really that good, even if it is $2.50 per 2.82-ounce packet (89 cents per ounce)!</p> <p>Yellowstone Jalapeño Gravy contains no artificial flavors, which to me is pretty impressive. Though not gluten-free like the aforementioned Simply Organic picks, it does at least contain fewer additives while still managing to achieve unbelievably thick results. You only need to use 2 cups of water per packet to cash in on this irresistibly luscious golden gravy; its texture was so rich and smooth my mouth watered just at the sight of it.</p> <p>Aside from its tantalizing consistency, Yellowstone Jalapeño Gravy tastes incredible — I'd describe its flavor as similar to high-quality jalapeño nacho cheese, but with less emphasis on the cheese. It's quite spicy, and though not unbearably so, still isn't something I'd recommend offering to kids. All in all, Yellowstone Jalapeño Gravy is an amazing option I'd buy over and over again — try it on fried chicken cutlets, potatoes, stuffing, or hot sandwiches. Yum!</p> <p>The 12 powdered gravy mixes selected for this article were chosen based on availability in my area, with most sourced from Walmart and Amazon. Each gravy mix was ranked primarily based on texture and flavor, although other factors, like ingredients and pricing, were considered. As always, pricing and availability are subject to change.</p> <p style="margin-top: 25px;"> <a href="https://www.foodrepublic.com/2319646/powdered-gravy-mixes-ranked/" target="_blank" rel="nofollow noopener" style="color: #0d6efd; margin-bottom:20px;"><img src="https://www.foodrepublic.com/img/gallery/12-costco-cakes-you-should-be-picking-up-in-november-2026/l-intro-1795027951.jpg" alt="12 Costco Cakes You Should Be Picking Up In November 2026" style="max-width:100%; height:auto; border-radius:8px;" loading="lazy"></div> <div style="text-align:center; margin:20px 0;"> <script type="text/javascript"> atOptions = {'key' : 'f9e40eb3b3cd05f1038aac7b36b33ad2','format' : 'iframe','height' : 90,'width' : 728,'params' : {}}; </script> <script type="text/javascript" src="https://upholdbrilliancerecast.com/f9e40eb3b3cd05f1038aac7b36b33ad2/invoke.js"></script> </div> <div class="article-body" style="font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8; color: #333;"> <p>We may receive a commission on purchases made from links.</p> <p>From birthdays to holiday gatherings, a beautiful cake can be the star attraction and make an ordinary occasion feel extraordinary. Thanksgiving is right around the corner, and while pies are often the go-to dessert for this holiday, serving your guests something unexpected in the form of a cake can turn your dinner into a memorable feast, especially if they have multiple meals to attend. Sure, you can make one from scratch, but with all the activity and planning surrounding this holiday, you may just want to opt for something store-bought, and Costco offers the perfect solution.</p> <p>The Costco bakery offers a huge range, from decadent layer cakes in crowd-pleasing flavors to rich cheesecakes — which aren't technically cakes, though we're including them here anyway. There are also some Italian-style specialties, a truly seasonal option, and one flourless chocolate cake that will bring a touch of luxury to your table.</p> <p>Keep in mind that the wholesale club requires a membership for customers to shop there. If you're not already a member, this list of cakes may convince you to join. Just remember that prices and availability may vary by location and that some cakes may only be available to order online.</p> <p>When it comes to Thanksgiving, few people would argue with the idea that the holiday isn't complete without at least one pumpkin dessert. However, instead of serving the expected pie this year, opt for this cheesecake — in addition to a creamy base full of intense pumpkin flavor, the whole dessert is topped with pecans and a generous drizzle of caramel sauce.</p> <p>A two-pack of Ferrara's Bakery 8-inch Pumpkin Cheesecake with Caramel and Pecan Topping is available at Costco for $119.99.</p> <p>Panettone is an Italian delicacy made from a yeasted dough studded with dried and candied fruit, and it has a lightly sweet flavor and fluffy texture. This bready cake is incredibly versatile and can be the foundation for many fall recipes. Try tearing it into pieces to make a delicious bread pudding, or follow Giada De Laurentiis's suggestion for leftover panettone and use it to top a holiday salad.</p> <p>Chiostro di Saronno Panettone Classico is available at Costco for $29.99.</p> <p>Whether you're starting your day with a cup of joe, pausing for a midafternoon pick-me-up, or finishing a meal with coffee or tea, this cake from Collin Street Bakery should be on the table. It comes in a beautiful white tin and includes a cup of icing for drizzling, while the warming cinnamon spice feels like a hug on your palate. It also makes a beautiful gift.</p> <p>Collin Street Bakery Cinnamon Coffee Cake is available at Costco for $34.99.</p> <p>Collin Street Bakery is a Texas-based company, and the Lone Star State is known for producing pecans, so you're almost guaranteed to have delicious pecan flavor in this pair of cakes. Besides containing the rich nuts, each one is chock-full of either pineapple or glacéed apricots. The batter for these cakes is also sweetened with honey.</p> <p>Collin Street Bakery Apricot & Pineapple Pecan Cake Bundle is available at Costco for $64.99.</p> <p>For some, Christmas cannot arrive soon enough. Fortunately, Costco has a little preview of the holiday for these individuals in the form of this mini pecan cake bundle, which includes four favorite flavors: cherry fudge cake, pineapple cake, blonde cake, and a classic fruitcake. If you're wondering how fruitcakes can last all year, adding a heavy dose of alcohol can help preserve them.</p> <p>The Collin Street Bakery Mini Pecan Cake Bundle is available at Costco for $49.99.</p> <p>The Knipschildt brand once held the Guinness World Record for the most expensive chocolate truffle in the world, but you don't need to take out a loan to enjoy this dessert. This flourless cake features a layer of rich chocolate ganache and is finished with the chocolatier's signature truffles. It's a striking cake that will bring a bit of sophistication to your next gathering.</p> <p>Knipschildt Chocopologie Truffle Flourless Chocolate Cake is available at Costco for $69.99.</p> <p>Tiramisu may seem like tres leches, but it's an entirely different dessert. Its name translates to "lift me up," and while traditional versions may come in a square format, this one from Ferrara's Bakery is round and features an attractive collar of brown and white stripes. The bakery makes its own ladyfingers and douses them in coffee and coffee liqueur before layering them with sweetened mascarpone cheese.</p> <p>A two-pack of Ferrara's Bakery 8-inch Tiramisu Cake is available at Costco for $99.99.</p> <p>If you love the combination of chocolate and peanut butter, then this cake is for you. The base is made from a fudge brownie, and it's topped with layers of peanut butter mousse and decadent chocolate cake. As if that's not enough, the whole confection gets a crown of brownie pieces, chocolate fudge, and peanut butter chips.</p> <p>For the consummate chocolate lover, no other flavors should get in the way of a chocolate cake, and this one is nothing short of perfection. It starts with four layers of rich chocolate sponge sandwiching velvety milk chocolate mousse; then, the entire thing gets covered in chocolate ganache and a coating of chocolate shavings that resemble bark, making this cake look like an edible tree trunk. It's pre-sliced, too, ensuring that everyone gets a fair share.</p> <p>Sometimes simple is better, especially when you want to add your own personal touches to something, and this plain Jon Donaire cheesecake is a perfect example. Try drizzling it with dulce de leche and finishing it with chopped walnuts, or top it with apple pie filling and a sprinkling of mixed spices for an autumnal take on a classic. You can even cover it with poached pear halves.</p> <p>Jon Donaire 10-inch New York Cheesecake is available at Costco for $59.99.</p> <p>This carrot cake features thick layers of cake and cream cheese frosting and is covered with a generous coating of vanilla buttercream. For an elegant touch, it's topped with silk cherry blossoms, and comes in a striking box tied with a beautiful ribbon, too. If you're not a fan of nuts or raisins, this cake is free of both, so nothing gets in the way of the spiced carrot flavor.</p> <p>The Cake Bake Shop 8-inch Round Carrot Cake is available at Costco for $159.99.</p> <p style="margin-top: 25px;"> <a href="https://www.foodrepublic.com/2320915/best-costco-cakes-november-2026/" target="_blank" rel="nofollow noopener" style="color: #0d6efd; text-decoration: none; font-weight: bold;"> → Baca artikel asli </a> </p> </div> <div style="text-align:center; margin:20px 0;"> <script type="text/javascript"> atOptions = {'key' : 'f9e40eb3b3cd05f1038aac7b36b33ad2','format' : 'iframe','height' : 90,'width' : 728,'params' : {}}; </script> <script type="text/javascript" src="https://upholdbrilliancerecast.com/f9e40eb3b3cd05f1038aac7b36b33ad2/invoke.js"></script> </div> </div> </article> <article class="article-card" id="artikel-9711"> <h2>#9711. Psychopaths Use Language In A Way Most People Would Never Expect (M)</h2> <div class="article-body"> <div style="text-align:center; margin-bottom:20px;"><img src="https://www.spring.org.uk/images/surprised-1.jpg" alt="Psychopaths Use Language In A Way Most People Would Never Expect (M)" style="max-width:100%; height:auto; border-radius:8px;" loading="lazy"></div> <div style="text-align:center; margin:20px 0;"> <script type="text/javascript"> atOptions = {'key' : 'f9e40eb3b3cd05f1038aac7b36b33ad2','format' : 'iframe','height' : 90,'width' : 728,'params' : {}}; </script> <script type="text/javascript" src="https://upholdbrilliancerecast.com/f9e40eb3b3cd05f1038aac7b36b33ad2/invoke.js"></script> </div> <div class="article-body" style="font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8; color: #333;"> <p>The way people describe life’s turning points reveals three distinct traits associated with psychopathy.</p> <p>The way people describe life's turning points reveals three distinct traits associated with psychopathy.</p> <p>• Read members-only articles • Adverts removed • Cancel at any time • 14 day money-back guarantee for new members</p> <p>Psychologist, Jeremy Dean, PhD is the founder and author of PsyBlog. He holds a doctorate in psychology from University College London and two other advanced degrees in psychology. He has been writing about scientific research on PsyBlog since 2004. View all posts by Dr Jeremy Dean</p> <p style="margin-top: 25px;"> <a href="https://www.spring.org.uk/2026/10/psychopath-language.php" target="_blank" rel="nofollow noopener" style="color: #0d6efd; text-decoration: none; font-weight: bold;"> → Baca artikel asli </a> </p> </div> <div style="text-align:center; margin:20px 0;"> <script type="text/javascript"> atOptions = {'key' : 'f9e40eb3b3cd05f1038aac7b36b33ad2','format' : 'iframe','height' : 90,'width' : 728,'params' : {}}; </script> <script type="text/javascript" src="https://upholdbrilliancerecast.com/f9e40eb3b3cd05f1038aac7b36b33ad2/invoke.js"></script> </div> </div> </article> <article class="article-card" id="artikel-9710"> <h2>#9710. 16 pumpkin recipes, from cakes and cookies to bars and bread: We've got a marbled pumpkin cake, chewy pumpkin cookies, and even pumpkin milk bread.</h2> <div class="article-body"> <div style="text-align:center; margin-bottom:20px;"><img src="https://www.kingarthurbaking.com/sites/default/files/2026-08/Pumpkin-Snickerdoodle-Cookies_FALL-26_BOTW_2026_Action_H_0693.jpg" alt="16 pumpkin recipes, from cakes and cookies to bars and bread: We've got a marbled pumpkin cake, chewy pumpkin cookies, and even pumpkin milk bread." style="max-width:100%; height:auto; border-radius:8px;" loading="lazy"></div> <div style="text-align:center; margin:20px 0;"> <script type="text/javascript"> atOptions = {'key' : 'f9e40eb3b3cd05f1038aac7b36b33ad2','format' : 'iframe','height' : 90,'width' : 728,'params' : {}}; </script> <script type="text/javascript" src="https://upholdbrilliancerecast.com/f9e40eb3b3cd05f1038aac7b36b33ad2/invoke.js"></script> </div> <div class="article-body" style="font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8; color: #333;"> <p>It’s that time of year when pumpkin spice everything starts appearing on store shelves — candles, lip balm, air fresheners, beer, and of course, the ubiquitous PSL (pumpkin spice latte). That means fall is here, and more importantly, that pumpkin should make a grand return to your kitchen! Pull out your canned pumpkin — or better yet, make your own pumpkin purée — and stock your pantry with pumpkin pie spice, because we have the best pumpkin recipes to bake this fall.</p> <p>This Pumpkin Swirl Cake takes my breath away every time I unmold it from its intricate loaf pan. The anticipation keeps building until I slice into the pound cake-like loaf and reveal the swirled pattern inside, marbled with both vanilla and spiced pumpkin batter. (Don’t fret if you don’t have the specialty loaf pan — this can also be baked in a standard loaf pan and adorned with a simple confectioners’ sugar icing.)</p> <p>To make this recipe, you'll need: Patch O Pumpkins Loaf Pan and Pure Vanilla Plus</p> <p>To make this recipe, you'll need: Pumpkin Pie Spice and Sparkling Sugar</p> <p>A cousin of Belgian-style Liège waffles, these Pumpkin Sugar Crunch Waffles have caramelized edges and a pleasant chew that’s reminiscent of brioche. The yeasted batter has pumpkin in it for flavor and color, plus Swedish pearl sugar that melts into pockets of crispy sugar. The best part? The batter rests overnight, so if you prepare it the night ahead, all you have to do the next morning is scoop and cook the batter for hot, crispy waffles in just a few minutes.</p> <p>Get the recipe: Pumpkin Sugar Crunch Waffles</p> <p>To make this recipe, you'll need: Swedish Pearl Sugar</p> <p>I used to make the same pumpkin pie recipe for years, and it always left me wanting a little more excitement. Then I found this Smooth and Spicy Pumpkin Pie and never looked back! The generously spiced filling uses nutmeg, ginger, cloves, and Vietnamese cinnamon to create a more flavorful pie than traditional versions. The secret to its silky-smooth texture? Corn syrup, which is an invert sugar and keeps the custard from becoming grainy. Substitute another invert sugar like honey or maple syrup if you like; I use maple syrup.</p> <p>Get the recipe: Smooth and Spicy Pumpkin Pie</p> <p>To make this recipe, you'll need: Vietnamese Cinnamon, Ginger, and Nutmeg</p> <p>Whenever I have these tender, golden scones on hand, I look forward to getting out of bed the next morning because I know they’re waiting for me. They can be easily customized to use a range of mix-ins, depending on what you have in your pantry. My personal preference is a mix of crystallized ginger and Cinnamon Sweet Bits.</p> <p>Get the recipe: Harvest Pumpkin Scones (or Gluten-Free Pumpkin Scones)</p> <p>To make this recipe, you'll need: Mini Diced Ginger and Cinnamon Sweet Bits</p> <p>If you’re looking for a way to make your whole kitchen smell like fall, these one-bowl, easy pumpkin muffins deliver — and fast. They’re ready in under an hour, so you can spend less time measuring, mixing, and cleaning and more time tackling your autumn bucket list.</p> <p>To make this recipe, you'll need: Standard Muffin Pan</p> <p>Making banana bread is an almost weekly activity in my house — except during fall, when we pivot to pumpkin bread instead. This is a quick, easy bake that satisfies my craving for something pumpkin-y, and it uses a simple trick to concentrate the pumpkin flavor and ensure the loaf is perfectly textured: The pumpkin purée is reduced on the stovetop to cook off excess moisture. (The process is similar to browning butter.) As a result, the final loaf is packed with pumpkin flavor.</p> <p>Get the recipe: The Most Pumpkin Pumpkin Chocolate Chip Bread</p> <p>To make this recipe, you'll need: Ginger and Semisweet Chocolate Chips</p> <p>These bars have all the cozy, spiced goodness of the classic dessert in a portable, crowd-friendly form. The buttery, brown sugar crust gets pressed into the pan (no rolling out pie dough!), and the silky pumpkin filling comes together with just a handful of ingredients. The (optional but highly recommended) sour cream whipped topping brings a slight tanginess and completes the traditional pumpkin pie experience.</p> <p>To make this recipe, you'll need: Pumpkin Pie Spice</p> <p>This Pumpkin Milk Bread is exceptionally soft, squishy, and feather-light, while also packing in a lot of pumpkin. Pumpkin can often weigh down baked goods, but here the combination of a tangzhong, bread flour, and a long mix makes this bread simultaneously moist and high-rising.</p> <p>To make this recipe, you'll need: Instant Yeast</p> <p>This tender pumpkin crumb cake is for people who double the chocolate chips in pumpkin bread and the streusel on coffee cake. Atop the thin layer of spiced pumpkin cake lays a heavy blanket of buttery crumbs with a bold chocolate flavor, thanks to Dutch-processed cocoa powder.</p> <p>Get the recipe: Chocolate-Pumpkin Crumb Cake</p> <p>To make this recipe, you'll need: Black Cocoa</p> <p>These Pumpkin Cupcakes, with their piped swirl of cream cheese frosting, are the ideal way to celebrate fall birthdays. The cupcakes are super tender, thanks to the addition of cake flour and oil. Sour cream and brown sugar add tanginess and molasses-y sweetness while also preventing the cupcakes from being dry.</p> <p>For more cupcake decorating ideas, see our YouTube video: Decorate Cupcakes Better Than Ever.</p> <p>To make this recipe, you'll need: Cake Flour (or Gluten-Free Measure for Measure Flour)</p> <p>My husband’s favorite fall dessert is Pumpkin Whoopie Pies, hands down. He can’t resist these subtly sweet cakes sandwiching rich cream cheese filling. This recipe has a few extra bells and whistles to take it over the top: Bread and Cake Enhancer to keep the cakes extra soft and fresh, xanthan gum in the filling to give it a smooth mouthfeel, and diced crystallized ginger for a bit of extra zing in the filling.</p> <p>To make this recipe, you'll need: Bread and Cake Enhancer, Xanthan Gum, and Mini Diced Ginger</p> <p>The next time there’s a rainy weekend, I’m taking on a project bake: our Pumpkin Cream Cheese Danish. It’s a multiday process and laminating dough is a labor of love, but the final product is worth the effort: buttery, crisp pastries filled with pumpkin and sweet cream cheese.</p> <p>Get the recipe: Pumpkin Cream Cheese Danish</p> <p>To make this recipe, you'll need: Baker’s Special Dry Milk</p> <p>To make this recipe, you'll need: Pumpkin Pie Spice</p> <p>This Pumpkin Layer Cake with Cream Cheese Frosting is a show-stopping dessert featuring spiced layers of cake, not-too-sweet cream cheese frosting, and a blanket of melted caramel poured over the top. Will it be slightly messy to serve? Yes. Will anyone mind? Absolutely not.</p> <p>Get the recipe: Pumpkin Layer Cake with Cream Cheese Frosting</p> <p>To make this recipe, you'll need: Pumpkin Pie Spice and Offset Spatula</p> <p>The pumpkin spice recipe I’m most excited to bake this fall is a mash-up of greats: Part-coffee cake, part-Bundt cake, part-pumpkin bread, this Pumpkin Espresso Bundt Cake deserves a category all of its own. It has two layers of espresso swirl tucked within a moist, spiced cake. Make it in your favorite Bundt pan or serve it as a loaf if you’re more of simple-is-better person. Either way, it’s great for snacking all day long.</p> <p>Get the recipe: Pumpkin Espresso Bundt Cake</p> <p>To make this recipe, you'll need: Espresso Powder and Bundt Pan</p> <p>For more recipes that are ideal to bake as the seasons change, see our collection of Fall Favorites.</p> <p>Transform your favorite bread loaf into shareable rolls.</p> <p>Top tips from the Things Bakers Know podcast.</p> <p>See our complete collection of Recipes posts.</p> <p>It’s peak baking season — here’s what to make.</p> <p>Facebook TikTok Instagram Threads Pinterest LinkedIn YouTube Reddit Substack</p> <p style="margin-top: 25px;"> <a href="https://www.kingarthurbaking.com/blog/2026/10/05/pumpkin-recipes" target="_blank" rel="nofollow noopener" style="color: #0d6efd; text-decoration: none; font-weight: bold;"> → Baca artikel asli </a> </p> </div> <div style="text-align:center; margin:20px 0;"> <script type="text/javascript"> atOptions = {'key' : 'f9e40eb3b3cd05f1038aac7b36b33ad2','format' : 'iframe','height' : 90,'width' : 728,'params' : {}}; </script> <script type="text/javascript" src="https://upholdbrilliancerecast.com/f9e40eb3b3cd05f1038aac7b36b33ad2/invoke.js"></script> </div> </div> </article> <article class="article-card" id="artikel-9709"> <h2>#9709. The Egg McMuffin Order You Can Only Find In Canada</h2> <div class="article-body"> <div style="text-align:center; margin-bottom:20px;"><img src="https://www.foodrepublic.com/img/gallery/the-egg-mcmuffin-order-you-can-only-find-in-canada/l-intro-1794842228.jpg" alt="The Egg McMuffin Order You Can Only Find In Canada" style="max-width:100%; height:auto; border-radius:8px;" loading="lazy"></div> <div style="text-align:center; margin:20px 0;"> <script type="text/javascript"> atOptions = {'key' : 'f9e40eb3b3cd05f1038aac7b36b33ad2','format' : 'iframe','height' : 90,'width' : 728,'params' : {}}; </script> <script type="text/javascript" src="https://upholdbrilliancerecast.com/f9e40eb3b3cd05f1038aac7b36b33ad2/invoke.js"></script> </div> <div class="article-body" style="font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8; color: #333;"> <p>McDonald's breakfast is a thing of beauty, and if you think we've got it good here in the States, you probably haven't seen what's sitting on Canada's breakfast menu. Alongside familiar faves, you'll find items Americans can't order, the most envy-inducing among them arguably being the Egg BLT McMuffin. Once you hear what's in it, don't be surprised if you catch yourself planning a trip to our northern neighbor.</p> <p>The Egg BLT starts with McDonald's signature ring-shaped steamed (not fried) egg, paired with hickory-smoked bacon, crisp lettuce, and fresh tomato, then finished with a creamy, mayo-like sauce and a slice of cheese, all stacked on a toasted English muffin. A second version uses nearly identical ingredients but swaps the whole leaves for shredded lettuce. You can only get this variation at McDonald's restaurants located inside Walmart stores — part of a decades-old partnership that once placed roughly 1,000 outposts in the retail chain. McDonald's later closed hundreds of them as drive-thrus became the main source of sales, though Walmart continues to host many locations in Canada.</p> <p>To get your hands on an Egg BLT McMuffin in the U.S., you'll have to get creative. Your best bet is to start with a Bacon, Egg & Cheese McMuffin, which already ticks off half the ingredients. Ask for a touch of mayo, which gets you close to the sauce of the Canadian original. Since lettuce and tomatoes are lunchtime items, your odds improve near the end of breakfast hours when stores are prepping the lunch menu — you'll likely have to order them at the counter or window.</p> <p>The Egg BLT might have already convinced you to add McDonald's to your itinerary next time you're in Canada, but it's not the only breakfast item worth the detour. One that caught our eye was the Mighty McGriddles. While the U.S. offers the Bacon, Egg & Cheese and Sausage, Egg & Cheese varieties separately, the Canadian version puts both to shame by stacking a double helping of hickory-smoked bacon, a sausage patty, egg, and cheese between two maple-flavored griddle cakes — a gloriously overstuffed creation that lives up to its name. The Mighty McMuffin follows the same logic, coming loaded with both meats for anyone who can never decide between the two.</p> <p>Another familiar face on Canadian McDonald's breakfast menus is the bagel, though while America only offers plain, Canada also serves sesame and everything varieties. You can even order one toasted with butter or Philadelphia cream cheese — widely known as the best store-bought brand — as if you're at a proper bagel shop.</p> <p>Canada's McDonald's restaurants aren't afraid to put a twist on U.S. staples, and they also introduce new items altogether. You won't find chicken anywhere on the standard U.S. breakfast menu, which makes the Chicken McGriddles feel like a curveball up north. The simple yet delicious sandwich pairs a breaded chicken patty with two sweet, maple-flavored griddle cakes for some serious sweet-and-savory fusion.</p> <p style="margin-top: 25px;"> <a href="https://www.foodrepublic.com/2317657/egg-mcmuffin-order-only-find-canada/" target="_blank" rel="nofollow noopener" style="color: #0d6efd; text-decoration: none; font-weight: bold;"> → Baca artikel asli </a> </p> </div> <div style="text-align:center; margin:20px 0;"> <script type="text/javascript"> atOptions = {'key' : 'f9e40eb3b3cd05f1038aac7b36b33ad2','format' : 'iframe','height' : 90,'width' : 728,'params' : {}}; </script> <script type="text/javascript" src="https://upholdbrilliancerecast.com/f9e40eb3b3cd05f1038aac7b36b33ad2/invoke.js"></script> </div> </div> </article> <article class="article-card" id="artikel-9707"> <h2>#9707.
