LimeWire AI Studio Review 2023: Details, Pricing & Features</h2> <div class="article-body"> <div style="text-align:center; margin:20px 0;"> <script type="text/javascript"> atOptions = {'key' : 'f9e40eb3b3cd05f1038aac7b36b33ad2','format' : 'iframe','height' : 90,'width' : 728,'params' : {}}; </script> <script type="text/javascript" src="https://upholdbrilliancerecast.com/f9e40eb3b3cd05f1038aac7b36b33ad2/invoke.js"></script> </div> <div class="article-body" style="font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8; color: #333;"> <p><p style="text-align: left;"><span style="font-family: Oxygen;"> </span></p><p style="text-align: left;"><span style="font-family: Oxygen;">In the rapidly advancing landscape of AI technology and innovation, LimeWire emerges as a unique platform in the realm of generative AI tools. This platform not only stands out from the multitude of existing AI tools but also brings a fresh approach to content generation. LimeWire not only empowers users to create AI content but also provides creators with creative ways to share and monetize their creations.</span></p><p style="text-align: left;"><span style="font-family: Oxygen;"><br /></span></p><p><span style="font-family: Oxygen;">As we explore LimeWire, our aim is to uncover its features, benefits for creators, and the exciting possibilities it offers for AI content generation. This platform presents an opportunity for users to harness the power of AI in image creation, all while enjoying the advantages of a free and accessible service.</span></p><p><span style="font-family: Oxygen;"><br /></span></p><p><span style="font-family: Oxygen;">Let's unravel the distinctive features that set LimeWire apart in the dynamic landscape of AI-powered tools, understanding how creators can leverage its capabilities to craft unique and engaging AI-generated images.</span></p><h2 style="text-align: left;"><span style="font-family: Oxygen;"><br /></span></h2><h2 style="text-align: left;"><span style="font-family: Oxygen;">Introduction</span></h2><div><div class="separator" style="clear: both; text-align: center;"><a href="https://blogger.googleusercontent.com/img/b/R29vZ2xl/AVvXsEgjpMlV4umM2-ZY3vAwynTzCWwbk5_pjVyGQqGGftHzeOmpTyc4aYApxfanU29DyPfjUZz5ZhhDojKe8mpYUG6tcEezDQrg1NTDr8XOBequWD3LOpUKpea4AiaB5mhPpYZSxtk2lRfHnCSNhyphenhyphenXm53l80cTMNA_KtCMfDd9PQNzYWp6A4ylQJtUy_-7GpWsF/s1100/limewire-studio.jpg" style="margin-left: 1em; margin-right: 1em;"><span style="font-family: Oxygen;"><img alt="limewire" border="0" height="354" src="https://blogger.googleusercontent.com/img/b/R29vZ2xl/AVvXsEgjpMlV4umM2-ZY3vAwynTzCWwbk5_pjVyGQqGGftHzeOmpTyc4aYApxfanU29DyPfjUZz5ZhhDojKe8mpYUG6tcEezDQrg1NTDr8XOBequWD3LOpUKpea4AiaB5mhPpYZSxtk2lRfHnCSNhyphenhyphenXm53l80cTMNA_KtCMfDd9PQNzYWp6A4ylQJtUy_-7GpWsF/w640-h354/limewire-studio.jpg" title="limewire" width="640" /></span></a></div><span style="font-family: Oxygen;"><div><span><br /></span></div>LimeWire, a name once associated with the notorious file-sharing tool from the 2000s, has undergone a significant transformation. The LimeWire we discuss today is not the file-sharing application of the past but has re-emerged as an entirely new entity—a cutting-edge AI content publishing platform.</span></div><div><span style="font-family: Oxygen;"><br /></span></div><p><span style="font-family: Oxygen;">This revamped LimeWire invites users to register and unleash their creativity by crafting original AI content, which can then be shared and showcased on the LimeWire Studio. Notably, even acclaimed artists and musicians, such as Deadmau5, Soulja Boy, and Sean Kingston, have embraced this platform to publish their content in the form of NFT music, videos, and images.</span></p><p><span style="font-family: Oxygen;"><br /></span></p><p><span style="font-family: Oxygen;">Beyond providing a space for content creation and sharing, LimeWire introduces monetization models to empower users to earn revenue from their creations. This includes avenues such as earning ad revenue and participating in the burgeoning market of Non-Fungible Tokens (NFTs). As we delve further, we'll explore these monetization strategies in more detail to provide a comprehensive understanding of LimeWire's innovative approach to content creation and distribution.</span></p><p><span style="font-family: Oxygen;"><br /></span></p><p><span style="font-family: Oxygen;">LimeWire Studio welcomes content creators into its fold, providing a space to craft personalized AI-focused content for sharing with fans and followers. Within this creative hub, every piece of content generated becomes not just a creation but a unique asset—ownable and tradable. Fans have the opportunity to subscribe to creators' pages, immersing themselves in the creative journey and gaining ownership of digital collectibles that hold tradeable value within the LimeWire community. Notably, creators earn a 2.5% royalty each time their content is traded, adding a rewarding element to the creative process.</span></p><p><span style="font-family: Oxygen;"><br /></span></p><p><span style="font-family: Oxygen;">The platform's flexibility is evident in its content publication options. Creators can choose to share their work freely with the public or opt for a premium subscription model, granting exclusive access to specialized content for subscribers.</span></p><p><span style="font-family: Oxygen;"><br /></span></p><h2 style="text-align: left;"><span style="font-family: Oxygen;"><a href="https://limewire.com/studio?referrer=fll3a5fl9p" rel="nofollow" target="_blank">LimeWire AI Studio</a></span></h2><p><span style="font-family: Oxygen;">As of the present moment, LimeWire focuses on AI Image Generation, offering a spectrum of creative possibilities to its user base. The platform, however, has ambitious plans on the horizon, aiming to broaden its offerings by introducing AI music and video generation tools in the near future. This strategic expansion promises creators even more avenues for expression and engagement with their audience, positioning LimeWire Studio as a dynamic and evolving platform within the realm of AI-powered content creation.</span></p><p><span style="font-family: Oxygen;"><br /></span></p><h2 style="text-align: left;"><span style="font-family: Oxygen;">AI Image Generation Tools</span></h2><div><div class="separator" style="clear: both; text-align: center;"><a href="https://blogger.googleusercontent.com/img/b/R29vZ2xl/AVvXsEgDTFvirsSedRuEhryeV3Thmn7FWknlYW0Dsem9LJqFfty8EotENaiCNW1LKX4eDMzca19saIgLBIi9p5mh_qzeKz_JD5kqtgOhPXfRyQkPzT5Jc_QlUcAqTFPlV_6s7EBgmezCHUzosiDtmpoQDUK8fw9wYQyYsFBea3ahvFlDrx25ApnOuvZ0z7shxGJQ/s1100/ss.jpg" style="margin-left: 1em; margin-right: 1em;"><span style="font-family: Oxygen;"><img alt="limewire AI Studio" border="0" height="360" src="https://blogger.googleusercontent.com/img/b/R29vZ2xl/AVvXsEgDTFvirsSedRuEhryeV3Thmn7FWknlYW0Dsem9LJqFfty8EotENaiCNW1LKX4eDMzca19saIgLBIi9p5mh_qzeKz_JD5kqtgOhPXfRyQkPzT5Jc_QlUcAqTFPlV_6s7EBgmezCHUzosiDtmpoQDUK8fw9wYQyYsFBea3ahvFlDrx25ApnOuvZ0z7shxGJQ/w640-h360/ss.jpg" title="limewire-studio" width="640" /></span></a></div><span style="font-family: Oxygen;"><br /><span><br /></span></span></div><p><span style="font-family: Oxygen;">The <a href="https://limewire.com/studio?referrer=fll3a5fl9p" rel="nofollow" target="_blank">LimeWire AI image generation</a> tool presents a versatile platform for both the creation and editing of images. Supporting advanced models such as Stable Diffusion 2.1, Stable Diffusion XL, and DALL-E 2, LimeWire offers a sophisticated toolkit for users to delve into the realm of generative AI art.</span></p><p><span style="font-family: Oxygen;"><br /></span></p><p><span style="font-family: Oxygen;">Much like other tools in the generative AI landscape, LimeWire provides a range of options catering to various levels of complexity in image creation. Users can initiate the creative process with prompts as simple as a few words or opt for more intricate instructions, tailoring the output to their artistic vision.</span></p><p><span style="font-family: Oxygen;"><br /></span></p> <div id="container-67c1d379f2d23d1196246b2000d3b84a"></div><p><span style="font-family: Oxygen;">What sets LimeWire apart is its seamless integration of different AI models and design styles. Users have the flexibility to effortlessly switch between various AI models, exploring diverse design styles such as cinematic, digital art, pixel art, anime, analog film, and more. Each style imparts a distinctive visual identity to the generated AI art, enabling users to explore a broad spectrum of creative possibilities.</span></p><p><span style="font-family: Oxygen;"><br /></span></p><p><span style="font-family: Oxygen;">The platform also offers additional features, including samplers, allowing users to fine-tune the quality and detail levels of their creations. Customization options and prompt guidance further enhance the user experience, providing a user-friendly interface for both novice and experienced creators.</span></p><p><span style="font-family: Oxygen;"><br /></span></p> <div id="atContainer-504b591a28719b1270e09aa4045e24ab"></div><p><span style="font-family: Oxygen;">Excitingly, LimeWire is actively developing its proprietary AI model, signaling ongoing innovation and enhancements to its image generation capabilities. This upcoming addition holds the promise of further expanding the creative horizons for LimeWire users, making it an evolving and dynamic platform within the landscape of AI-driven art and image creation.</span></p><p><span style="font-family: Oxygen;"><a href="https://limewire.com/studio?referrer=fll3a5fl9p" rel="nofollow" target="_blank"><b>Sign Up Now To Get Free Credits</b></a></span></p><h2 style="text-align: left;"><span style="font-family: Oxygen;">Automatically Mint Your Content As NFTs</span></h2><div><div class="separator" style="clear: both; text-align: center;"><a href="https://blogger.googleusercontent.com/img/b/R29vZ2xl/AVvXsEjf5uANphXEeTKCeB-Tg6rP3FKyDwWXxpqsBjL7VbB-RI5QSxzwu2Gbe30uqF6F8vs9GrPmZM2irLG7MESNkgUgsGAzIudbJLBkfoB1Bm3SS5GUh6_OlUb1u3xLgj6aZWAHlt61cIMptbPN9oII-0pi4g4gsW2TsWHT-ZQdD3_w8hyphenhyphenhJndSAj5G0SVhLtBB/s1100/m.jpg" style="margin-left: 1em; margin-right: 1em;"><span style="font-family: Oxygen;"><img alt="limewire" border="0" height="368" src="https://blogger.googleusercontent.com/img/b/R29vZ2xl/AVvXsEjf5uANphXEeTKCeB-Tg6rP3FKyDwWXxpqsBjL7VbB-RI5QSxzwu2Gbe30uqF6F8vs9GrPmZM2irLG7MESNkgUgsGAzIudbJLBkfoB1Bm3SS5GUh6_OlUb1u3xLgj6aZWAHlt61cIMptbPN9oII-0pi4g4gsW2TsWHT-ZQdD3_w8hyphenhyphenhJndSAj5G0SVhLtBB/w640-h368/m.jpg" title="limewire" width="640" /></span></a></div><span style="font-family: Oxygen;"><br /><span><br /></span></span></div><p><span style="font-family: Oxygen;">Upon completing your creative endeavor on LimeWire, the platform allows you the option to publish your content. An intriguing feature follows this step: LimeWire automates the process of minting your creation as a Non-Fungible Token (NFT), utilizing either the Polygon or Algorand blockchain. This transformative step imbues your artwork with a unique digital signature, securing its authenticity and ownership in the decentralized realm.</span></p><p><span style="font-family: Oxygen;"><br /></span></p><p><span style="font-family: Oxygen;">Creators on LimeWire hold the power to decide the accessibility of their NFT creations. By opting for a public release, the content becomes discoverable by anyone, fostering a space for engagement and interaction. Furthermore, this choice opens the avenue for enthusiasts to trade the NFTs, adding a layer of community involvement to the artistic journey.</span></p><p><span style="font-family: Oxygen;"><br /></span></p><p><span style="font-family: Oxygen;">Alternatively, LimeWire acknowledges the importance of exclusivity. Creators can choose to share their posts exclusively with their premium subscribers. In doing so, the content remains a special offering solely for dedicated fans, creating an intimate and personalized experience within the LimeWire community. This flexibility in sharing options emphasizes LimeWire's commitment to empowering creators with choices in how they connect with their audience and distribute their digital creations.</span></p><p><span style="font-family: Oxygen;"><br /></span></p><p><span style="font-family: Oxygen;">After creating your content, you can choose to publish the content. It will automatically mint your creation as an NFT on the Polygon or Algorand blockchain. You can also choose whether to make it public or subscriber-only.</span></p><p><span style="font-family: Oxygen;"><br /></span></p><p><span style="font-family: Oxygen;">If you make it public, anyone can discover your content and even trade the NFTs. If you choose to share the post only with your premium subscribers, it will be exclusive only to your fans.</span></p><p><span style="font-family: Oxygen;"><br /></span></p><h2 style="text-align: left;"><span style="font-family: Oxygen;">Earn Revenue From Your Content</span></h2><p><span style="font-family: Oxygen;">Additionally, you can earn ad revenue from your content creations as well.</span></p><p><span style="font-family: Oxygen;">When you publish content on LimeWire, you will receive 70% of all ad revenue from other users who view your images, music, and videos on the platform.</span></p><p><span style="font-family: Oxygen;"><br /></span></p><p><span style="font-family: Oxygen;">This revenue model will be much more beneficial to designers. You can experiment with the AI image and content generation tools and share your creations while earning a small income on the side.</span></p><p><br /></p><h3 style="text-align: left;"><span style="font-family: Oxygen;">LMWR Tokens</span></h3><p><span style="font-family: Oxygen;">The revenue you earn from your creations will come in the form of LMWR tokens, LimeWire’s own cryptocurrency.</span></p><p><span style="font-family: Oxygen;">Your earnings will be paid every month in LMWR, which you can then trade on many popular crypto exchange platforms like Kraken, ByBit, and UniSwap.</span></p><p><span style="font-family: Oxygen;">You can also use your LMWR tokens to pay for prompts when using LimeWire generative AI tools.</span></p><h2 style="text-align: left;"><span style="font-family: Oxygen;">Pricing Plans</span></h2><p><span style="font-family: Oxygen;">You can sign up to LimeWire to use its AI tools for free. You will receive 10 credits to use and generate up to 20 AI images per day. You will also receive 50% of the ad revenue share. However, you will get more benefits with premium plans.</span></p><h4 style="text-align: left;"><ul style="text-align: left;"><li><span style="font-family: Oxygen;">Basic plan: </span></li></ul></h4><p style="text-align: left;"><span style="font-family: Oxygen;">For $9.99 per month, you will get 1,000 credits per month, up to 2 ,000 image generations, early access to new AI models, and 50% ad revenue share</span></p><h4 style="text-align: left;"><ul style="text-align: left;"><li><span style="font-family: Oxygen;">Advanced plan: </span></li></ul></h4><p><span style="font-family: Oxygen;">For $29 per month, you will get 3750 credits per month, up to 7500 image generations, early access to new AI models, and 60% ad revenue share</span></p><h4 style="text-align: left;"><ul style="text-align: left;"><li><span style="font-family: Oxygen;">Pro plan: </span></li></ul></h4><p><span style="font-family: Oxygen;">For $49 per month, you will get 5,000 credits per month, up to 10,000 image generations, early access to new AI models, and 70% ad revenue share</span></p> <div id="atContainer-2060cf2f0491455d459b6b7a0ee275f3"></div><h4 style="text-align: left;"><ul style="text-align: left;"><li><span style="font-family: Oxygen;">Pro Plus plan: </span></li></ul></h4><p><span style="font-family: Oxygen;">For $99 per month, you will get 11,250 credits per month, up to 2 2,500 image generations, early access to new AI models, and 70% ad revenue share</span></p><p><span style="font-family: Oxygen;">With all premium plans, you will receive a Pro profile badge, full creation history, faster image generation, and no ads.</span></p><p><span style="font-family: Oxygen;"><a href="https://limewire.com/studio?referrer=fll3a5fl9p" rel="nofollow" target="_blank"><b>Sign Up Now To Get Free Credits</b></a></span></p><h2 style="text-align: left;"><span style="font-family: Oxygen;">Conclusion</span></h2><p><span style="font-family: Oxygen;">In conclusion, LimeWire emerges as a democratizing force in the creative landscape, providing an inclusive platform where anyone can unleash their artistic potential and effortlessly share their work. With the integration of AI, LimeWire eliminates traditional barriers, empowering designers, musicians, and artists to publish their creations and earn revenue with just a few clicks.</span></p><p><span style="font-family: Oxygen;"><br /></span></p><p><span style="font-family: Oxygen;">The ongoing commitment of LimeWire to innovation is evident in its plans to enhance generative AI tools with new features and models. The upcoming expansion to include music and video generation tools holds the promise of unlocking even more possibilities for creators. It sparks anticipation about the diverse and innovative ways in which artists will leverage these tools to produce and publish their own unique creations.</span></p><p><span style="font-family: Oxygen;"><br /></span></p><p><span style="font-family: Oxygen;">For those eager to explore, LimeWire's AI tools are readily accessible for free, providing an opportunity to experiment and delve into the world of generative art. As LimeWire continues to evolve, creators are encouraged to stay tuned for the launch of its forthcoming AI music and video generation tools, promising a future brimming with creative potential and endless artistic exploration</span></p></p> <p style="margin-top: 25px;"> <a href="https://techncruncher.blogspot.com/2023/12/limewire-ai-studio-review-2023-details.html" target="_blank" rel="nofollow noopener" style="color: #0d6efd; text-decoration: none; font-weight: bold;"> → Baca artikel asli </a> </p> </div> <div style="text-align:center; margin:20px 0;"> <script type="text/javascript"> atOptions = {'key' : 'f9e40eb3b3cd05f1038aac7b36b33ad2','format' : 'iframe','height' : 90,'width' : 728,'params' : {}}; </script> <script type="text/javascript" src="https://upholdbrilliancerecast.com/f9e40eb3b3cd05f1038aac7b36b33ad2/invoke.js"></script> </div> </div> </article> <article class="article-card" id="artikel-9705"> <h2>#9705. </script> <script type="text/javascript" src="https://upholdbrilliancerecast.com/f9e40eb3b3cd05f1038aac7b36b33ad2/invoke.js"></script> </div> </div> </article> <article class="article-card" id="artikel-9704"> <h2>#9704. 14 French Desserts You Should Try Once In Your Life</h2> <div class="article-body"> <div style="text-align:center; margin-bottom:20px;"><img src="https://www.foodrepublic.com/img/gallery/14-french-desserts-you-should-try-once-in-your-life/l-intro-1794863727.jpg" alt="14 French Desserts You Should Try Once In Your Life" style="max-width:100%; height:auto; border-radius:8px;" loading="lazy"></div> <div style="text-align:center; margin:20px 0;"> <script type="text/javascript"> atOptions = {'key' : 'f9e40eb3b3cd05f1038aac7b36b33ad2','format' : 'iframe','height' : 90,'width' : 728,'params' : {}}; </script> <script type="text/javascript" src="https://upholdbrilliancerecast.com/f9e40eb3b3cd05f1038aac7b36b33ad2/invoke.js"></script> </div> <div class="article-body" style="font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8; color: #333;"> <p>French cuisine is largely known for its decadent textures, flavors, and presentations, and this includes a long list of regional desserts. We all know about croissants, and, yes, when infused with the right sweet elements, they definitely count as a dessert, but that's just the tip of the iceberg when it comes to French desserts. In fact, there is a seemingly never-ending list of eye-catching sweet treats that hail from the country. The ones found below, though, are so mouthwateringly delicious that everyone should try them at least once in their lives.</p> <p>If you aren't already familiar with French desserts, it doesn't matter if you are fluent in the language or not; the names of the country's culinary creations don't always alert you to what they actually are. With this in mind, if you're interested in sampling a few — why wouldn't you be? — but aren't sure where to start, we can help point you in the right direction. So, get your fork and spoon ready, because once you learn about the collection of French desserts below, you'll be dying to get your hands on them.</p> <p>The tart Tatin may have a fancy name, but don't let that fool you. It is actually akin to an apple pie, just flipped upside down — and there's nothing extravagant about that. The French version of the dessert also has humble origins. As the story goes, in the late 1800s, Caroline (of Caroline and Stephanie Tatin's Inn, located south of Paris) forgot to put a crust on the bottom of her apple pie. Due to being exceptionally busy, she decided to put it on top instead and see what would happen. When she took it out of the oven and flipped it over, she saw that her misstep led to a happy result: The apples were beautifully caramelized. When she served it to the inn's guests, it was an immediate success, and the tarte Tatin was officially born.</p> <p>Creating a tart Tatin is fairly accessible to novice home cooks. It only calls for five ingredients: apples, flour, butter, eggs, and sugar. The trickiest part is arranging the slices of fruit in a decorative way on the bottom of the pan. Actually, despite her massive culinary repertoire, Ina Garten admits it is the recipe she makes most because it is not only delicious, but easy to create, as well. If it's good enough for Garten to come back time and time again, you'd better believe it's a French dessert everyone should give a go at least once.</p> <p>Crème brûlée is one of the most easily recognizable and widely popular French desserts in the United States, but, interestingly enough, its origins are somewhat disputed. France, England, and Spain all claim to be the birthplace of the dessert. Regardless, since its invention, wherever that happened to be, there's no doubt it has fully integrated itself into traditional French cuisine, and if you've never had the joy of eating one before, you are truly missing out.</p> <p>In its most basic format, crème brûlée is made with just four ingredients: egg yolks, sugar, heavy cream, and vanilla bean. While simple, the elements come together to form a creamy, custardy delight. Then, the top is scorched to form a layer of burnt sugar that's to die for. Topping it with a couple of fresh berries is also customary, but either way, it is simplicity at its finest. In fact, this is one case where the sum is much greater than its parts. In addition to the sweet, rich flavor of the custard itself, part of the fun of eating one is using a spoon to crack the burnt layer on top. It not only adds a caramelized taste but contributes textural variation, and that is always a plus. Whether you decide to try your hand at making crème brûlée yourself or choose to seek it out from a restaurant, it's a French dessert that's worth your attention.</p> <p>Éclairs have been around since the 1860s, and today, they are one of the more popular French desserts found in the United States. For good reason, too; they are tasty enough to go down in a flash. Speaking of which, the word directly translates to lightning.</p> <p>Name and popularity aside, éclairs are made with choux pastry, which is similar to doughnut pastry, but devoid of baking soda, baking powder, and yeast, and relies on steam to rise. As a result, after being formed into long cylindrical pieces, the dough cooks up to be exceptionally light and airy. That's just the start of the legendary éclair, though. They are also filled with pastry cream or custard and then topped with either fondant or ganache icing — both of which are harder styles of icing, so you can still feel free to enjoy éclairs with your hands.</p> <p>Arguably, the most popular flavor of éclair is chocolate, but thanks to the versatility of the choux pastry shell, they are welcoming to a world of other flavors as well. Everything from caramel to pistachio to Nutella to strawberry to matcha with chocolate and beyond can be found enhancing the delightful little pastry.</p> <p>French yogurt cake, or gâteaux au yaourt in the native language, is another easy yet extremely satisfying dessert that deserves some time in the spotlight. In France, it is a popular recipe for kids to learn, likely because of the simple recipe, which calls for three eggs, one part oil, one part yogurt, two parts sugar, three parts flour, and leavening. Even so, when it comes out of the oven, you have a drool-worthy, slightly tangy cake that is moister than pound cake (if you can fathom that) while still presenting a delicate crumb.</p> <p>Since French yogurt cake is not a common restaurant offering, if you want to give it a taste, you'll likely have to make one yourself. Or, at the very least, enlist a friend to do it — um, mom? Thankfully, though, it is one of the more straightforward must-try French desserts out there, so it should be attainable for even the most novice home cooks. The simplicity of the French yogurt cake also makes it prime for a plethora of flavor infusions. So, if you want to add citrus, or brandy, or fruit to the mix, go right ahead.</p> <p>Crêpes are a delicately thin pancake-like creation that's ready and waiting for a world of flavor and ingredient infusions. Still, a Crêpes Suzette is quite possibly the most delicious and famous version of them all. It consists of classic crêpes in a sauce made of sugar, orange juice, and an orange liqueur, like Gran Marnier. The entire thing is also smothered in brandy and set on fire, which leads to a caramelized, citrusy, sweet flambé sauce that will draw just about anyone in. Heck, even watching a chef prepare one catches the eye, and that's why it's often done in full view when ordered in a restaurant.</p> <p>Interestingly enough, crêpes Suzette is another iconic French dessert that was first created by accident — and this particular story is not disputed. In 1895, Henri Carpentier, a 14-year-old assistant waiter at the Maitre at Monte Carlo's Cafe Paris, was preparing dessert for the Prince of Wales (who'd later become King Edward VII of England). While doing so, he accidentally caught the cordials he was working with on fire, and instead of becoming flustered and starting over from scratch, he tasted the sauce and realized he'd come up with something extraordinary.</p> <p>Don't let the flambé scare you too much if you want to try creating one at home; it truly does lead to exceptional flavor. However, you can still make a tasty rendition sans the potential fire hazard; it just won't be quite as authentic.</p> <p>First and foremost, Mont Blanc is known for being the highest mountain in the Alps. However, for those in the know, it is also a delectable French sweet treat with Alpine-inspired appeal. In fact, when created, the Mont Blanc dessert resembles a snow-capped mountain peak, so the name is more than fitting. The exact origins of it is uncertain, but a reigning theory is that it was developed in Paris, France, in the 19th century. During that era, chestnuts started to grow in popularity in the region, and people began incorporating them into sweet dishes, instead of the customary savory ones.</p> <p>The main components of a Mont Blanc dessert are as follows: It starts with a crisp meringue base, which is topped with thin strands of chestnut purée, and then finished off with a pile of whipped cream. Traditionally, a vermicelli tip is used to pipe the chestnut puree, but other shapes are also common. Either way, though, the yummy chestnut puree is the star of the show, offering a nutty, rich flavor that offsets the creamy whipped cream and meringue in a delightful way.</p> <p>Hailing from the Basque region in southwest France, the Gâteau Basque became widely popular in the 19th century. Its growth in the culinary scene is largely attributed to a particular baker, Marianne Hirigoyen, who first sold them in local markets before opening a brick-and-mortar bakery. Since then, the gâteau Basque's acceptance into French culinary tradition has been more than cemented. Actually, fast-forward to today, and there's now a museum and a two-day festival in October dedicated to the dessert. If that doesn't tell you exactly why it is a must-try French recipe, we don't know what would.</p> <p>Whether you call them canelé, cannelé de Bordeaux, or canelé Bordelais, these yummy little French pastries are time-consuming to make — the dough needs to rest for up to 24 hours before baking. Even so, their delectable mix of textures and delicious buttery, custard-y flavors are worth the effort used to make them and then some.</p> <p>Small and cylindrical with fluted edges, the center of canelés are made with flour, milk, sugar, butter, vanilla bean, eggs, salt, and rum. Once mixed with care, the dough rests for an extended time before baking in copper molds. After they're cooked, a delicious coating of edible beeswax and butter fills the molds and is also poured over the top before baking again. When that's done, you're left with delicious bite-sized (well, almost) custard-filled cakes featuring a caramelized crust on the exterior. Considering miniature copper fluted molds are not a customary tool in most homes, canelés aren't the first dessert we recommend trying to make at home. However, if you ever see them in a French bakery or restaurant, you'd be a fool not to give them a try.</p> <p>Opera cake is one of the coffee desserts that are always worth ordering, and guess what? It's also a French dessert everyone should try at least once. That is, of course, if you know what's good for you — and in this case, we truly hope you do.</p> <p>Created by Cyrique Gavillon, the opera cake is just as much a thing of beauty as it is a delectable flavor wonderland. A rectangular-shaped cake at heart, it is made with alternating layers of coffee syrup-soaked almond cake, buttercream, and ganache, and then topped with a rich dark chocolate icing. Once completed, it not only looks stunning, but provides your palate with a mix of nutty, chocolatey, creamy, rich, coffee flavors that are hard to beat. Yes, it sounds a whole lot like tiramisu when the elements are taken at face value, but it is a delightful dessert all its own when it comes to how the ingredients come together. Plus, it's French, not Italian. Just saying.</p> <p>While simple to make, the Île flottante presents itself as an elegant dish, and as such, is a mainstay in French cuisine. In fact, while it's said French people prefer to purchase dessert from a local bakery, it is one recipe many natives still have in their repertoire. It just so happened to be Julia Child's favorite old-school dessert, as well. Since she is credited with bringing French cuisine to the United States and helping it grow in popularity, following her lead regarding the greatest culinary hits of the country just makes sense.</p> <p>Similar to éclairs, which we've already discussed, profiteroles are made with hollowed-out choux pastry, filled with custard or cream, and topped with icing. What sets them apart is their shape. Instead of being long and cylindrical, profiteroles are formed into small bite-sized balls. As a result, they are the perfect sweet treat for bringing to a gathering or munching on if you simply want a few bites. However, once you get a taste of their scrumptious textures and flavors, trying to eat just one will be quite a complicated task.</p> <p>Again, like éclairs, the most common icing flavor for profiteroles is chocolate. Still, they come in a myriad of other flavors, as well, so they have what it takes to pique the interest of many. For example, if chocolate is too one-dimensional for you — we are judging you — you can also make chocolate hazelnut profiteroles, vanilla ones, or just about any other flavor you can dream up.</p> <p>Last but certainly not least on our list of French desserts you need to try is clafoutis. The name may sound posh, but it's actually another sweet treat that's incredibly easy to make, so you don't have to be an established French baker to create one at home. Plus, it may be a dessert, but it is also acceptable to eat it for breakfast. Okay, now we are really listening.</p> <p>Clafoutis consists of fruit smothered with a thick custard made from sugar, flour, milk, and eggs. The texture is akin to flan, but undeniably has all the French flair a Francophile could want. Most traditionally, cherries create the meaty fruit of clafoutis, but other berries and fruits, like raspberries, are also commonly used to pull off the recipe. While not necessarily a dessert, if you want to go in a savory direction, fruit can also be substituted for prosciutto, cheese, and tomatoes, so think of it like a choose-your-own-adventure type dish. No matter how you build it, though, clafoutis is one French creation that deserves more recognition, at least in the States.</p> <p style="margin-top: 25px;"> <a href="https://www.foodrepublic.com/2318490/french-desserts-try-once-in-a-lifetime/" target="_blank" rel="nofollow noopener" style="color: #0d6efd; text-decoration: none; font-weight: bold;"> → Baca artikel asli </a> </p> </div> <div style="text-align:center; margin:20px 0;"> <script type="text/javascript"> atOptions = {'key' : 'f9e40eb3b3cd05f1038aac7b36b33ad2','format' : 'iframe','height' : 90,'width' : 728,'params' : {}}; </script> <script type="text/javascript" src="https://upholdbrilliancerecast.com/f9e40eb3b3cd05f1038aac7b36b33ad2/invoke.js"></script> </div> </div> </article> <article class="article-card" id="artikel-9703"> <h2>#9703. What are flour enzymes?: Understanding a common flour ingredient.</h2> <div class="article-body"> <div style="text-align:center; margin-bottom:20px;"><img src="https://www.kingarthurbaking.com/sites/default/files/2026-10/flour%20enzymes%202.jpg" alt="What are flour enzymes?: Understanding a common flour ingredient." style="max-width:100%; height:auto; border-radius:8px;" loading="lazy"></div> <div style="text-align:center; margin:20px 0;"> <script type="text/javascript"> atOptions = {'key' : 'f9e40eb3b3cd05f1038aac7b36b33ad2','format' : 'iframe','height' : 90,'width' : 728,'params' : {}}; </script> <script type="text/javascript" src="https://upholdbrilliancerecast.com/f9e40eb3b3cd05f1038aac7b36b33ad2/invoke.js"></script> </div> <div class="article-body" style="font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8; color: #333;"> <p>If you look closely at a bag of King Arthur flour, you may see an unfamiliar ingredient listed there: enzyme.</p> <p>We’re extremely thoughtful about every ingredient we use, across all King Arthur products and recipes. Our Food Philosophy guides every decision to ensure the quality of what we create, and that includes the enzymes in our flour.</p> <p>Here’s exactly what flour enzymes are and why they’re included in flour.</p> <p>Enzymes are found naturally in wheat, and thus are already present in flour. An enzyme is a protein produced by a living organism that acts as a catalyst to bring about a specific biochemical reaction.</p> <p>The amount of enzymes in flour can vary based on growing conditions from harvest to harvest and year to year, so we add natural enzymes to correct for any variance and make sure our flour bakes more consistently — in other words, to make your baking even better. Those enzymes make up a very small portion of the total flour: less than 1%.</p> <p>The enzyme we use in our flour is technically called fungal alpha-amylase. That’s a pretty technical name, so it is commonly labeled simply as “enzyme” on ingredient labels. “Alpha-amylase” is the actual enzyme, and “fungal” refers to the fact that the living organism that produces the enzyme is a fungus, not unlike yeast or a mushroom. Amylase may sound unfamiliar, but your body makes and uses it every day. When you eat, it begins breaking starch into smaller carbohydrates so you can draw on it for energy. Amylases added to flour perform a similar function.</p> <p>Note: Though fungi are technically living organisms, enzymes are considered vegan, as they are not animal based.</p> <p>Malted barley is an alternative source of enzymes that King Arthur has used in the past, but we found the efficacy can vary batch to batch. By swapping malted barley for straight enzymes, the flour produces more consistent results for our bakers.</p> <p>Another reason we made the switch? Enzymes require less water and energy to produce than malt barley. As a Certified B Corporation, we're committed to being good stewards of our planet, so pivoting to a responsibly sourced ingredient with a smaller environmental footprint makes sense.</p> <p>To put it simply, enzymes are added to flours to improve baking performance — they do not change the flour's nutritional value. More specifically, they help create the foods that feeds yeasts. The enzymes break down complex starches into simpler sugars; this, in turn, provides yeast with readily available fermentable sugar (food!), which enables yeast to work continuously and supports both fermentation and crust browning. This results in improved bread volume and crumb texture. Most other manufacturers of flour and yeasted mixes use enzymes for the very same reasons.</p> <p>Ultimately, enzymes are yet another way for us to provide you with the most consistent flour — which means even better baking.</p> <p>Cover photo and food styling by Liz Neily.</p> <p>Transform your favorite bread loaf into shareable rolls.</p> <p>Top tips from the Things Bakers Know podcast.</p> <p>See our complete collection of Tips and Techniques posts.</p> <p>A baker’s guide to our new T85 Baker's Reserve Bread Flour.</p> <p>A guide to baking with self-rising flour.</p> <p>The best baking starts with the best flour.</p> <p>It all comes down to gluten-forming protein content.</p> <p>Facebook TikTok Instagram Threads Pinterest LinkedIn YouTube Reddit Substack</p> <p style="margin-top: 25px;"> <a href="https://www.kingarthurbaking.com/blog/2026/10/15/flour-enzymes" target="_blank" rel="nofollow noopener" style="color: #0d6efd; text-decoration: none; font-weight: bold;"> → Baca artikel asli </a> </p> </div> <div style="text-align:center; margin:20px 0;"> <script type="text/javascript"> atOptions = {'key' : 'f9e40eb3b3cd05f1038aac7b36b33ad2','format' : 'iframe','height' : 90,'width' : 728,'params' : {}}; Verge: Corner Controls</h2> <div class="article-body"> <div style="text-align:center; margin:20px 0;"> <script type="text/javascript"> atOptions = {'key' : 'f9e40eb3b3cd05f1038aac7b36b33ad2','format' : 'iframe','height' : 90,'width' : 728,'params' : {}}; </script> <script type="text/javascript" src="https://upholdbrilliancerecast.com/f9e40eb3b3cd05f1038aac7b36b33ad2/invoke.js"></script> </div> <div class="article-body" style="font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8; color: #333;"> <p><p> Swipe a screen corner to set brightness, volume and more </p> <p> <a href="https://www.producthunt.com/products/verge-corner-controls?utm_campaign=producthunt-atom-posts-feed&utm_medium=rss-feed&utm_source=producthunt-atom-posts-feed">Discussion</a> | <a href="https://www.producthunt.com/r/p/1325261?app_id=339">Link</a> </p></p> <p style="margin-top: 25px;"> <a href="https://www.producthunt.com/products/verge-corner-controls" target="_blank" rel="nofollow noopener" style="color: #0d6efd; text-decoration: none; font-weight: bold;"> → Baca artikel asli </a> </p> </div> <div style="text-align:center; margin:20px 0;"> <script type="text/javascript"> atOptions = {'key' : 'f9e40eb3b3cd05f1038aac7b36b33ad2','format' : 'iframe','height' : 90,'width' : 728,'params' : {}}; </script> <script type="text/javascript" src="https://upholdbrilliancerecast.com/f9e40eb3b3cd05f1038aac7b36b33ad2/invoke.js"></script> </div> </div> </article> <article class="article-card" id="artikel-9701"> <h2>#9701. Zapyso</h2> <div class="article-body"> <div style="text-align:center; margin:20px 0;"> <script type="text/javascript"> atOptions = {'key' : 'f9e40eb3b3cd05f1038aac7b36b33ad2','format' : 'iframe','height' : 90,'width' : 728,'params' : {}}; </script> <script type="text/javascript" src="https://upholdbrilliancerecast.com/f9e40eb3b3cd05f1038aac7b36b33ad2/invoke.js"></script> </div> <div class="article-body" style="font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8; color: #333;"> <p><p> Free meeting notes and dictation that stay on your Mac </p> <p> <a href="https://www.producthunt.com/products/zapyso?utm_campaign=producthunt-atom-posts-feed&utm_medium=rss-feed&utm_source=producthunt-atom-posts-feed">Discussion</a> | <a href="https://www.producthunt.com/r/p/1320097?app_id=339">Link</a> </p></p> <p style="margin-top: 25px;"> <a href="https://www.producthunt.com/products/zapyso" target="_blank" rel="nofollow noopener" style="color: #0d6efd; text-decoration: none; font-weight: bold;"> → Baca artikel asli </a> </p> </div> <div style="text-align:center; margin:20px 0;"> <script type="text/javascript"> atOptions = {'key' : 'f9e40eb3b3cd05f1038aac7b36b33ad2','format' : 'iframe','height' : 90,'width' : 728,'params' : {}}; </script> <script type="text/javascript" src="https://upholdbrilliancerecast.com/f9e40eb3b3cd05f1038aac7b36b33ad2/invoke.js"></script> </div> </div> </article> <article class="article-card" id="artikel-9700"> <h2>#9700. Forget Butter Or Mayo: Spread This Rich Ingredient On Bread For Heartier Grilled Cheese</h2> <div class="article-body"> <div style="text-align:center; margin-bottom:20px;"><img src="https://www.foodrepublic.com/img/gallery/forget-butter-or-mayo-spread-this-rich-ingredient-on-bread-for-heartier-grilled-cheese/l-intro-1794599282.jpg" alt="Forget Butter Or Mayo: Spread This Rich Ingredient On Bread For Heartier Grilled Cheese" style="max-width:100%; height:auto; border-radius:8px;" loading="lazy"></div> <div style="text-align:center; margin:20px 0;"> <script type="text/javascript"> atOptions = {'key' : 'f9e40eb3b3cd05f1038aac7b36b33ad2','format' : 'iframe','height' : 90,'width' : 728,'params' : {}}; </script> <script type="text/javascript" src="https://upholdbrilliancerecast.com/f9e40eb3b3cd05f1038aac7b36b33ad2/invoke.js"></script> </div> <div class="article-body" style="font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8; color: #333;"> <p>A grilled cheese is already plenty hearty, but the common tip of using cured meats to increase its satisfying flavor — like in this tasty maple bacon variation — may interfere with your filling's texture if you prefer a smooth, gooey filling. Duck fat is the perfect way around this because it adds meatiness without changing any other ingredients, enriching the bread with umami with just a single smear.</p> <p>Duck fat is one of the most prized cooking fats in the culinary world because it has a higher smoke point than butter (around 375 degrees Fahrenheit) and a beautifully silky texture rich in subtle, meaty flavors. Just like spreading it on burger buns, using duck fat on grilled cheese can give you crispier bread because you can cook it at a higher temperature. When left at room temperature, it has a consistency similar to softened butter, making it easy to spread or drop in a pan, depending on your preference. Its unique composition of fats and subtle meaty flavor mean you'll notice its richness even in small amounts. Though it has a touch of gaminess, it's quite subtle and serves to elevate creamy and aged cheeses alike with an added layer of complexity.</p> <p>Using duck fat on grilled cheese is pretty easy, but there are a few tricks that can really maximize your results. Blending it with another fat, using it for some added seasoning, and picking the right pan can all give you the perfect sandwich.</p> <p>Mixing a fat with a high smoke point with one that burns more easily is a simple way to combine the best of both worlds. The richness of butter is irreplaceable, but you can incorporate some of duck fat's higher-heat cooking properties by swirling the two together before spreading the mix on your bread. Similarly, you can also bring your duck fat to a low, gentle simmer and add herbs and aromatics to flavor it beforehand. Whether you do this when rendering the fat yourself or just for a few minutes before adding your sandwich, a bit of sage can lend tremendous depth, while a smashed clove of garlic can mimic the rich flavor of toum.</p> <p>While a nonstick pan is great for butter since it doesn't retain as much heat, you might want to go in the opposite direction for duck fat. A heavy cast iron or stainless steel skillet helps prevent the surface temperature from dropping when you add the sandwich, maintaining that lovely heat that makes duck fat work so well. Plus, animal fats are great for cast iron's seasoning, helping you maintain your pan's coating while you cook!</p> <p style="margin-top: 25px;"> <a href="https://www.foodrepublic.com/2316459/forget-butter-mayo-heartier-grilled-cheese-ingredient-duck-fat/" target="_blank" rel="nofollow noopener" style="color: #0d6efd; text-decoration: none; font-weight: bold;"> → Baca artikel asli </a> </p> </div> <div style="text-align:center; margin:20px 0;"> <script type="text/javascript"> atOptions = {'key' : 'f9e40eb3b3cd05f1038aac7b36b33ad2','format' : 'iframe','height' : 90,'width' : 728,'params' : {}}; </script> <script type="text/javascript" src="https://upholdbrilliancerecast.com/f9e40eb3b3cd05f1038aac7b36b33ad2/invoke.js"></script> </div> </div> </article> <article class="article-card" id="artikel-9699"> <h2>#9699. Heavy cream vs. whipping cream: What's the difference?: Understanding the right cream for your baking.</h2> <div class="article-body"> <div style="text-align:center; margin-bottom:20px;"><img src="https://www.kingarthurbaking.com/sites/default/files/2026-10/heavy%20cream%20vs%20whipped%20cream.jpg" alt="Heavy cream vs. whipping cream: What's the difference?: Understanding the right cream for your baking." style="max-width:100%; height:auto; border-radius:8px;" loading="lazy"></div> <div style="text-align:center; margin:20px 0;"> <script type="text/javascript"> atOptions = {'key' : 'f9e40eb3b3cd05f1038aac7b36b33ad2','format' : 'iframe','height' : 90,'width' : 728,'params' : {}}; </script> <script type="text/javascript" src="https://upholdbrilliancerecast.com/f9e40eb3b3cd05f1038aac7b36b33ad2/invoke.js"></script> </div> <div class="article-body" style="font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8; color: #333;"> <p>If you’re baking a recipe that calls for heavy cream, or picking up a carton to turn into whipped cream to finish a dessert, you may be confused when you hit the dairy aisle. There’s “heavy cream” — but also “heavy whipping cream” or, in some cases, just “whipping cream.”</p> <p>So when it comes to heavy cream versus whipping cream, is there truly a difference?</p> <p>Aside from being delicious, there are very specific definitions and standards that must be met in order for something to be labeled as heavy cream. It is made by separating the fatty top layer from the base milk layer during processing. The FDA states that heavy cream is cream that contains no less than 36% milk fat.  Comparatively, milk has 0% to around 3% milk fat, as well as a higher water concentration. Because of its fat content, heavy cream retains a rich taste and, when whipped, it excels at creating stiff peaks that hold their shape for a long time.</p> <p>Whipping cream — sometimes called “heavy whipping cream” — is made using a similar process as heavy cream and is also the milk fat removed before milk is homogenized. However, whipping cream can contain somewhere between 30% and 35% milk fat content, according to FDA regulations. Because of its slightly lower fat content, it whips into a softer, more billowy cream, and it will deflate more quickly than whipped cream made with heavy cream.</p> <p>Luckily, the difference in taste and performance between the two types of cream are not very discernible. This means you can use them interchangeably in recipes — and it's okay if you accidentally buy the "wrong" one. Both can yield a delicious bowl of homemade whipped cream. (Can’t justify buying a whole carton of either one? We’ve got you covered with an easy homemade heavy cream substitute.)</p> <p>A note on King Arthur recipes: The King Arthur Test Kitchen prefers heavy cream in most instances, particularly when making whipped cream, because of the higher fat content. That said, you can substitute heavy whipping cream 1:1 in any King Arthur recipe that calls specifically for heavy cream without any issue.</p> <p>As a general rule of thumb, use heavy cream for making stable whipped cream for topping pies, layered desserts like tiramisu or banana pudding, and any sweet where the structural integrity hinges on the cream really holding its shape. Heavy cream can also be handy for making cream scones and drop biscuits, where the richness of the dairy can shine through. For more heavy cream baking inspiration, check out these 12 recipes that call on heavy cream.</p> <p>Cover photo by Danielle Sykes; food styling by Kaitlin Wayne.</p> <p>Justine Lee is a food writer, recipe developer, and culinary consultant based in New York City. In her free time, she is actively on a hunt for a good almond croissant.</p> <p>Transform your favorite bread loaf into shareable rolls.</p> <p>Top tips from the Things Bakers Know podcast.</p> <p>See our complete collection of Tips and Techniques posts.</p> <p>A fun party trick and a handy pie tip, all in one.</p> <p>A trip to your garden (or pantry) opens up a world of whipped cream options.</p> <p>The tip that'll give you portable, made-to-order whipped cream.</p> <p>Facebook TikTok Instagram Threads Pinterest LinkedIn YouTube Reddit Substack</p> <p style="margin-top: 25px;"> <a href="https://www.kingarthurbaking.com/blog/2026/10/19/heavy-cream-vs-whipping-cream" target="_blank" rel="nofollow noopener" style="color: #0d6efd; Add This Crunchy Ingredient To Ground Beef For Lighter Steakhouse Burgers (Hint: It's Not Breadcrumbs)</h2> <div class="article-body"> <div style="text-align:center; margin-bottom:20px;"><img src="https://www.foodrepublic.com/img/gallery/add-this-crunchy-ingredient-to-ground-beef-for-lighter-steakhouse-burgers-hint-its-not-breadcrumbs/l-intro-1795124164.jpg" alt="Add This Crunchy Ingredient To Ground Beef For Lighter Steakhouse Burgers (Hint: It's Not Breadcrumbs)" style="max-width:100%; height:auto; border-radius:8px;" loading="lazy"></div> <div style="text-align:center; margin:20px 0;"> <script type="text/javascript"> atOptions = {'key' : 'f9e40eb3b3cd05f1038aac7b36b33ad2','format' : 'iframe','height' : 90,'width' : 728,'params' : {}}; </script> <script type="text/javascript" src="https://upholdbrilliancerecast.com/f9e40eb3b3cd05f1038aac7b36b33ad2/invoke.js"></script> </div> <div class="article-body" style="font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8; color: #333;"> <p>We may receive a commission on purchases made from links.</p> <p>The actual difference between a hamburger and a steakburger comes down to the quality of meat used in the grind, but the difference between a homemade steakburger and one from a steakhouse is all about a lighter texture. Melissa Clark, author of "The Big Book of Dinner: Recipes and Rules (and How to Break Them)," tells us that achieving that characteristic is quite easy if you use ground cracker crumbs.</p> <p>"Any kind of cracker or breadcrumbs will make a burger lighter," Clark says. "Ritz and saltines work really well. They are very airy, which helps lighten the ground meat." Beef is rather dense, even if you avoid overworking it into a firm, puck-like consistency that's more similar to sausage than a tender patty. But a quarter cup of ground crackers per pound of meat can make a world of difference.</p> <p>When meat cooks, it contracts and releases juice and fat. Crackers, however, absorb them rather than allowing them to seep out of the patty, preventing it from shriveling up too much. Since steakhouse burgers typically use thick patties, this also keeps them nice and moist. Whereas a thin sliver of well-crusted beef may be just what you want in a smashburger, retaining moisture is a vital component to keeping your steakhouse burgers not only light, but also at their peak flavor.</p> <p>Using plain, unsalted crackers can still keep your steakhouse burgers light, but it would be a missed opportunity for better flavor. While you also don't want to use something starch-free, like a nut- or seed-based variety, Melissa Clark is a big believer in picking a tasty brand and smashing them up properly.</p> <p>"Using crackers can add great flavor – Ritz, with their butteriness, are especially lovely," Clark explains. Flavorful but unobtrusive, Ritz crackers are the perfect addition to any savory dish because just about everything can benefit from their toasty richness. But if you want to get a bit experimental, you can also just as easily use Cheez-Its or anything seasoned. This is an easy way to avoid coming up with a specialty spice blend since you'll be adding enough to thoroughly flavor your meat.</p> <p>Clark is also a proponent of using whatever method you can to grind the crackers into a fine powder. "Grind the crackers in a food processor, blender or tuck them in a plastic bag and crush them under a rolling pin," she added. Large chunks can make some bites unexpectedly soggy and, if using a seasoned cracker, a little too flavorful. Plus, if some parts of your blend don't have a starch, they may end up expressing their juices too much, leaving some bites juicy and light and others dense and dry.</p> <p style="margin-top: 25px;"> <a href="https://www.foodrepublic.com/2322461/add-crunchy-ingredient-ground-beef-lighter-steakhouse-burgers-not-breadcrumbs/" target="_blank" rel="nofollow noopener" style="color: #0d6efd; text-decoration: none; font-weight: bold;"> → Baca artikel asli </a> </p> </div> <div style="text-align:center; margin:20px 0;"> <script type="text/javascript"> atOptions = {'key' : 'f9e40eb3b3cd05f1038aac7b36b33ad2','format' : 'iframe','height' : 90,'width' : 728,'params' : {}}; </script> <script type="text/javascript" src="https://upholdbrilliancerecast.com/f9e40eb3b3cd05f1038aac7b36b33ad2/invoke.js"></script> </div> </div> </article> <article class="article-card" id="artikel-9695"> <h2>#9695. One Ingredient In Our Earliest Diets Linked To 33% Lower Anxiety Risk Later In Life (M)</h2> <div class="article-body"> <div style="text-align:center; margin-bottom:20px;"><img src="https://www.spring.org.uk/images/baby-sugar.jpg" alt="One Ingredient In Our Earliest Diets Linked To 33% Lower Anxiety Risk Later In Life (M)" style="max-width:100%; height:auto; border-radius:8px;" loading="lazy"></div> <div style="text-align:center; margin:20px 0;"> <script type="text/javascript"> atOptions = {'key' : 'f9e40eb3b3cd05f1038aac7b36b33ad2','format' : 'iframe','height' : 90,'width' : 728,'params' : {}}; </script> <script type="text/javascript" src="https://upholdbrilliancerecast.com/f9e40eb3b3cd05f1038aac7b36b33ad2/invoke.js"></script> </div> <div class="article-body" style="font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8; color: #333;"> <p>What can a policy that ended in 1953 tell us about anxiety today? Researchers followed the clues across decades.</p> <p>What can a policy that ended in 1953 tell us about anxiety today? How to clean cast iron  : It’s simpler than you think.</h2> <div class="article-body"> <div style="text-align:center; margin-bottom:20px;"><img src="https://www.kingarthurbaking.com/sites/default/files/2026-10/How%20to%20Clean%20Cast%20Iron_Blog_2026_Shot%201_0070.jpg" alt="How to clean cast iron  : It’s simpler than you think." style="max-width:100%; height:auto; border-radius:8px;" loading="lazy"></div> <div style="text-align:center; margin:20px 0;"> <script type="text/javascript"> atOptions = {'key' : 'f9e40eb3b3cd05f1038aac7b36b33ad2','format' : 'iframe','height' : 90,'width' : 728,'params' : {}}; </script> <script type="text/javascript" src="https://upholdbrilliancerecast.com/f9e40eb3b3cd05f1038aac7b36b33ad2/invoke.js"></script> </div> <div class="article-body" style="font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8; color: #333;"> <p>Despite what you may have heard, cleaning and maintaining a cast iron skillet or Dutch oven isn’t difficult. It’s practically impossible to ruin a well-seasoned skillet, and despite your best efforts, sometimes food will stick. If your cast iron is covered in stuck-on bits of cheese from a batch of Crispy Cheesy Pan Pizza, here's how to clean it.</p> <p>We can settle the debate once and for all: Yes, you can use soap to clean your cast iron. Dishwashing soap will not damage the seasoning that makes your skillet non-stick. Polymerized oil creates the layer of seasoning through heat, and dish soap isn’t strong enough to break that bond.</p> <p>No, you cannot clean a cast iron skillet in the dishwasher. This will degrade the seasoning layer and cause it to rust.</p> <p>You should not soak a cast iron pan either; the water will cause it to rust. If you do end up rusting your pan, you can still rescue it by scrubbing off the rust then re-seasoning the pan.</p> <p>Using warm, soapy water, scrub the pan with a stiff-bristled brush or sponge to remove any food residue. Avoid harsh, abrasive scrubbers like steel wool or metal pads, which can strip the pan of its seasoning.</p> <p>Once cleaned, fully dry the pan with a kitchen towel, or place it onto a burner over low heat so the water fully evaporates. Don’t walk away from the pan — it can quickly get smoky once the water has evaporated.</p> <p>Regardless of which method you prefer, it’s imperative that the pan is fully dry. Water (not soap!) is the enemy of cast iron, which can cause it to rust. Once dry, add a few drops of neutral oil and spread all over the pan with a towel.</p> <p>Photography by Patrick Marinello; styling by Yekaterina Boytsova</p> <p>Transform your favorite bread loaf into shareable rolls.</p> <p>Top tips from the Things Bakers Know podcast.</p> <p>See our complete collection of Tips and Techniques posts.</p> <p>Topping inspiration for your favorite pizza</p> <p>Facebook TikTok Instagram Threads Pinterest LinkedIn YouTube Reddit Substack</p> <p style="margin-top: 25px;"> <a href="https://www.kingarthurbaking.com/blog/2026/10/21/how-to-clean-cast-iron" target="_blank" rel="nofollow noopener" style="color: #0d6efd; text-decoration: none; font-weight: bold;"> → Baca artikel asli </a> </p> </div> <div style="text-align:center; margin:20px 0;"> <script type="text/javascript"> atOptions = {'key' : 'f9e40eb3b3cd05f1038aac7b36b33ad2','format' : 'iframe','height' : 90,'width' : 728,'params' : {}}; </script> <script type="text/javascript" src="https://upholdbrilliancerecast.com/f9e40eb3b3cd05f1038aac7b36b33ad2/invoke.js"></script> </div> </div> </article> <article class="article-card" id="artikel-9693"> <h2>#9693. TeaserKit</h2> <div class="article-body"> <div style="text-align:center; margin:20px 0;"> <script type="text/javascript"> atOptions = {'key' : 'f9e40eb3b3cd05f1038aac7b36b33ad2','format' : 'iframe','height' : 90,'width' : 728,'params' : {}}; </script> <script type="text/javascript" src="https://upholdbrilliancerecast.com/f9e40eb3b3cd05f1038aac7b36b33ad2/invoke.js"></script> </div> <div class="article-body" style="font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8; color: #333;"> <p><p> your coding agent directs your launch video </p> <p> <a href="https://www.producthunt.com/products/teaserkit?utm_campaign=producthunt-atom-posts-feed&utm_medium=rss-feed&utm_source=producthunt-atom-posts-feed">Discussion</a> | <a href="https://www.producthunt.com/r/p/1323133?app_id=339">Link</a> </p></p> <p style="margin-top: 25px;"> <a href="https://www.producthunt.com/products/teaserkit" target="_blank" rel="nofollow noopener" style="color: #0d6efd; text-decoration: none; font-weight: bold;"> → Baca artikel asli </a> </p> </div> <div style="text-align:center; margin:20px 0;"> <script type="text/javascript"> atOptions = {'key' : 'f9e40eb3b3cd05f1038aac7b36b33ad2','format' : 'iframe','height' : 90,'width' : 728,'params' : {}}; </script> <script type="text/javascript" src="https://upholdbrilliancerecast.com/f9e40eb3b3cd05f1038aac7b36b33ad2/invoke.js"></script> </div> </div> </article> <article class="article-card" id="artikel-9692"> <h2>#9692. Store-Bought Hummus Is 10x Better When You Add A Scoop Of This Condiment</h2> <div class="article-body"> <div style="text-align:center; margin-bottom:20px;"><img src="https://www.foodrepublic.com/img/gallery/store-bought-hummus-is-10x-better-when-you-add-a-scoop-of-this-condiment/l-intro-1794844313.jpg" alt="Store-Bought Hummus Is 10x Better When You Add A Scoop Of This Condiment" style="max-width:100%; height:auto; border-radius:8px;" loading="lazy"></div> <div style="text-align:center; margin:20px 0;"> <script type="text/javascript"> atOptions = {'key' : 'f9e40eb3b3cd05f1038aac7b36b33ad2','format' : 'iframe','height' : 90,'width' : 728,'params' : {}}; </script> <script type="text/javascript" src="https://upholdbrilliancerecast.com/f9e40eb3b3cd05f1038aac7b36b33ad2/invoke.js"></script> </div> <div class="article-body" style="font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8; color: #333;"> <p>We may receive a commission on purchases made from links.</p> <p>Among the most iconic Middle Eastern dishes, hummus blends chickpeas, tahini, olive oil, lemon juice, and optional seasonings to delicious effect. It's a dish that can be assembled at home, but many tasty store-bought versions are available, too. If your grocery store hummus happens to taste a little flat, though, reach for toum. Just a spoonful of this condiment will make a version that's 10 times better.</p> <p>Hailing from Lebanon, toum is an emulsion made by blending a generous dose of garlic with oil, lemon juice, and sometimes water. Smooth and airy in texture yet with an underlying bite, it lends hummus a dose of garlicky goodness and acidity, readily transforming a bland flavor into a complex one. Plus, the condiment packs in extra fat, helping to improve the perceived creaminess of disappointingly dry hummus. Since toum is a homogeneous paste, it's easy to incorporate, and its flavor can be less aggressive than raw garlic, too.</p> <p>You won't need much toum to make an impact. Start by mixing in just under a teaspoon per standard 8-ounce container, then work in gradual increments from there. For ease, grab a jar of toum online, or peruse the same grocery aisles where you bought the hummus. You could also easily prep your own toum in bulk — the condiment typically keeps for up to a month in the fridge.</p> <p>A toum-inflected hummus makes a great dip, scooped up with za'atar-dusted pita chips, pretzels, veggie chips, or whatever other crisp your heart desires. Note that there are many other ways to use hummus in everyday cooking, though — especially when it's mixed with toum.</p> <p>For example, consider topping the condiment with spiced ground beef or lamb, a popular Middle Eastern combination. Flavor the minced meat with earthy spices and fiery chilies, and the garlicky hummus makes for a mouthwatering flavor combo, turning the store-bought dip into an extra-hearty meal.</p> <p>Alternatively, make the chickpea-based dip less of a centerpiece and use it as a sandwich spread instead — it would pair delectably with crunchy vegetables like cucumbers and onions, as well as greens like spinach. Served on whole-grain bread, the dip makes for a delicious vegetarian meal.</p> <p>Looking for an extra creative twist? You could even use the toum hummus to make your next batch of tuna salad — the garlicky flavor will pair terrifically with the tinned fish. When you're craving Middle Eastern flavors but don't feel like cooking, keep the toum-hummus pairing in mind.</p> <p style="margin-top: 25px;"> <a href="https://www.foodrepublic.com/2317728/store-bought-hummus-10x-better-scoop-toum-condiment/" target="_blank" rel="nofollow noopener" style="color: #0d6efd; text-decoration: none; font-weight: bold;"> → Baca artikel asli </a> </p> </div> <div style="text-align:center; margin:20px 0;"> <script type="text/javascript"> atOptions = {'key' : 'f9e40eb3b3cd05f1038aac7b36b33ad2','format' : 'iframe','height' : 90,'width' : 728,'params' : {}}; </script> <script type="text/javascript" src="https://upholdbrilliancerecast.com/f9e40eb3b3cd05f1038aac7b36b33ad2/invoke.js"></script> </div> </div> </article> <article class="article-card" id="artikel-9691"> <h2>#9691. You're in the right place! The digital landscape has evolved dramatically, and AI tools have become essential for creators who want to stay ahead of the curve. In this guide, I'll show you the top 10 AI tools that are revolutionizing content creation and making creators' lives easier.</span></p><p><b><span style="font-family: Coda;">Why You Need These AI Tools in 2025</span></b></p><p><span style="font-family: Coda;">Content creation has become more demanding than ever. Whether you're a social media influencer, marketer, or business owner, keeping up with the constant need for fresh, engaging content can be overwhelming. Its ability to generate, edit, and optimize content while maintaining brand voice and industry expertise makes it an essential tool for creators who need to produce high-quality written content at scale.</span></p><h3 style="text-align: left;"><span style="font-family: Coda;">Key Features:</span></h3><p></p><ul style="text-align: left;"><li><span style="font-family: Coda;">Advanced content generation</span></li><li><span style="font-family: Coda;">SEO optimization</span></li><li><span style="font-family: Coda;">Brand voice maintenance</span></li><li><span style="font-family: Coda;">Research capabilities</span></li><li><span style="font-family: Coda;">Multi-format adaptation</span></li></ul><p></p><h3 style="text-align: left;"><span style="font-family: Coda;">Pricing:</span></h3><p></p><ul style="text-align: left;"><li><span style="font-family: Coda;">Free tier available</span></li><li><span style="font-family: Coda;">Plus: $20/month</span></li><li><span style="font-family: Coda;">Pro: $200/month</span></li></ul><p></p><h4 style="text-align: left;"><span style="font-family: Coda;">Perfect For: <span style="font-weight: normal;">Content writers, marketers, and businesses needing consistent, high-quality written content.</span></span></h4><h2 style="text-align: left;"><span style="font-family: Coda;">2. <a href="https://www.canva.com/" rel="nofollow" target="_blank">Canva Magic Studio</a>: Visual Design and Social Media Content Creation</span></h2><p><span style="font-family: Coda;"><b>What Makes It Special:</b> Canva Magic Studio has transformed the graphic design landscape by combining its user-friendly interface with powerful AI capabilities. The platform's ability to understand design principles and automatically generate on-brand content while maintaining professional aesthetics makes it accessible for beginners while providing enough sophistication for professional designers.</span></p><p><b><span style="font-family: Coda;">Key Features:</span></b></p><p></p><ul style="text-align: left;"><li><span style="font-family: Coda;">AI design generation</span></li><li><span style="font-family: Coda;">Brand kit integration</span></li><li><span style="font-family: Coda;">Magic resize</span></li><li><span style="font-family: Coda;">Animation tools</span></li><li><span style="font-family: Coda;">Template library</span></li></ul><p><b><span style="font-family: Coda;">Pricing:</span></b></p><p></p><ul style="text-align: left;"><li><span style="font-family: Coda;">Free tier available</span></li><li><span style="font-family: Coda;">Pro: $6.50/user/month</span></li><li><span style="font-family: Coda;">Teams: $5/user/month</span></li></ul><p></p><p><span style="font-family: Coda;"><b>Perfect For:</b> Small businesses, social media managers, and anyone needing quick, professional-looking designs.</span></p><h2 style="text-align: left;"><span style="font-family: Coda;">3. <a href="https://runwayml.com/" rel="nofollow" target="_blank">RunwayML</a> : AI Video Generator</span></h2><p><span style="font-family: Coda;"><b>What Makes It Special: </b>RunwayML stands out as the ultimate video creation powerhouse by combining professional-grade effects with user-friendly AI technology. Its ability to generate natural-looking presentations in multiple languages with synchronized lip movements and gestures makes it invaluable for creators who need to produce video content at scale without the traditional filming process.</span></p><p><b><span style="font-family: Coda;">Key Features:</span></b></p><p></p><ul style="text-align: left;"><li><span style="font-family: Coda;">AI avatar Video creation</span></li><li><span style="font-family: Coda;">Multi-language support</span></li><li><span style="font-family: Coda;">Custom avatar options</span></li><li><span style="font-family: Coda;">Professional templates</span></li><li><span style="font-family: Coda;">Script to video conversion</span></li></ul><p><b><span style="font-family: Coda;">Pricing:</span></b></p><p></p><ul style="text-align: left;"><li><span style="font-family: Coda;">Free tier available</span></li><li><span style="font-family: Coda;">Starter: $18/month</span></li><li><span style="font-family: Coda;">Creator: $64/month</span></li><li><span style="font-family: Coda;">Enterprise: Custom pricing</span></li></ul><p></p><p><span style="font-family: Coda;"><b>Perfect For:</b> Businesses and educators creating training videos, presentations, and multilingual content.</span></p><h2 style="text-align: left;"><span style="font-family: Coda;">6. <a href="https://www.descript.com/" rel="nofollow" target="_blank">Descript</a>: Podcast and Video Editing with Transcription Features</span></h2><p><span style="font-family: Coda;"><b>What Makes It Special:</b> Descript has transformed audio and video editing by making it as simple as editing a text document. Its innovative approach to media editing, combined with powerful AI features like automatic transcription and filler word removal, makes professional-quality editing accessible to creators of all skill levels.</span></p><p><b><span style="font-family: Coda;">Key Features:</span></b></p><p></p><ul style="text-align: left;"><li><span style="font-family: Coda;">Text-based video editing</span></li><li><span style="font-family: Coda;">Automatic transcription</span></li><li><span style="font-family: Coda;">Filler word removal</span></li><li><span style="font-family: Coda;">Screen recording</span></li><li><span style="font-family: Coda;">Collaborative editing</span></li></ul><p></p><p><b><span style="font-family: Coda;">Pricing:</span></b></p><p></p><ul style="text-align: left;"><li><span style="font-family: Coda;">Hobbyist: $12/month</span></li><li><span style="font-family: Coda;">Creator: $24/month</span></li><li><span style="font-family: Coda;">Business: $40/month</span></li><li><span style="font-family: Coda;">Enterprise: Custom pricing</span></li></ul><p></p><p><span style="font-family: Coda;"><b>Perfect For:</b> Podcasters, video creators, and teams needing efficient audio/video editing solutions.</span></p><h2 style="text-align: left;"><span style="font-family: Coda;">7. <a href="https://elevenlabs.io/" rel="nofollow" target="_blank">ElevenLabs</a>: AI VOICE GENERATION</span></h2><p><span style="font-family: Coda;"><b>What Makes It Special:</b> ElevenLabs has revolutionized voice synthesis by achieving unprecedented levels of natural speech quality and emotional expression. Its ability to clone voices accurately and generate multiple languages with proper accents and inflections makes it the ultimate tool for creators who need professional-quality voiceovers without the traditional recording process or voice actor limitations.</span></p><p><b><span style="font-family: Coda;">Key Features:</span></b></p><p></p><ul style="text-align: left;"><li><span style="font-family: Coda;">Ultra-realistic voice synthesis</span></li><li><span style="font-family: Coda;">Voice cloning capability</span></li><li><span style="font-family: Coda;">Multi-language support</span></li><li><span style="font-family: Coda;">Emotion control</span></li><li><span style="font-family: Coda;">Real-time generation</span></li></ul><p></p><p><b><span style="font-family: Coda;">Pricing:</span></b></p><p></p><ul style="text-align: left;"><li><span style="font-family: Coda;">Free tier available</span></li><li><span style="font-family: Coda;">Starter: $5/month</span></li><li><span style="font-family: Coda;">Creator: $11/month</span></li><li><span style="font-family: Coda;">Pro: $99/month</span></li><li><span style="font-family: Coda;">Scale: $330/month</span></li><li><span style="font-family: Coda;">Business: $1321/month</span></li></ul><ul style="text-align: left;"><li><span style="font-family: Coda;">Enterprise: Custom pricing</span></li></ul><p></p><p><span style="font-family: Coda;"><b>Perfect For:</b> Podcasters, video creators, and content creators needing professional voiceovers in multiple languages.</span></p><h2 style="text-align: left;"><span style="font-family: Coda;">8. <a href="https://tribescaler.com/" rel="nofollow" target="_blank">Tribescaler</a>: Viral Content and Headline Optimization</span></h2><p><span style="font-family: Coda;">What Makes It Special: Tribescaler brings a scientific approach to viral content creation by combining trend analysis with content optimization. Its powerful AI engine analyzes successful content patterns across platforms and provides actionable insights to help creators craft content that's more likely to go viral, while maintaining authenticity and audience engagement.</span></p><p><b><span style="font-family: Coda;">Key Features:</span></b></p><p></p><ul style="text-align: left;"><li><span style="font-family: Coda;">Viral content prediction</span></li><li><span style="font-family: Coda;">Trend analysis</span></li><li><span style="font-family: Coda;">Content optimization</span></li><li><span style="font-family: Coda;">Performance tracking</span></li><li><span style="font-family: Coda;">Multi-platform scheduling</span></li></ul><p></p><p><b><span style="font-family: Coda;">Pricing:</span></b></p><p></p><ul style="text-align: left;"><li><span style="font-family: Coda;">Free tier available</span></li><li><span style="font-family: Coda;">Pro: $49/month</span></li></ul><p></p><p><span style="font-family: Coda;"><b>Perfect For:</b> Content creators and social media managers focused on maximizing reach and engagement.</span></p><h2 style="text-align: left;"><span style="font-family: Coda;">9. <a href="https://www.clickable.com/" rel="nofollow" target="_blank">Clickable</a>: Automated Ad Creation and Optimization</span></h2><p><span style="font-family: Coda;">What Makes It Special: Clickable revolutionizes ad creation by seamlessly blending data-driven insights with creative automation. Its ability to analyze brand assets and automatically generate platform-optimized ad variations while maintaining brand voice transforms the tedious process of ad creation into a streamlined, results-driven workflow that consistently delivers high-performing content.</span></p><p><b><span style="font-family: Coda;">Key Features:</span></b></p><p></p><ul style="text-align: left;"><li><span style="font-family: Coda;">Automated ad creation</span></li><li><span style="font-family: Coda;">Multi-platform optimization</span></li><li><span style="font-family: Coda;">Built-in A/B testing</span></li><li><span style="font-family: Coda;">Performance analytics</span></li><li><span style="font-family: Coda;">Template library</span></li></ul><p></p><p><span style="font-family: Coda;"><b>Perfect For: </b>Digital marketers and businesses looking to scale their ad production efficiently.</span></p><h2 style="text-align: left;"><span style="font-family: Coda;">10. <a href="https://www.copy.ai/" rel="nofollow" target="_blank">Copy AI</a></span></h2><p><span style="font-family: Coda;"><b> What Makes It Special:</b> CopyAI has established itself as a powerhouse in AI-powered copywriting by offering specialized content generation for various marketing formats. Its sophisticated understanding of marketing psychology and brand voice, combined with its ability to generate compelling copy across multiple formats and industries, makes it invaluable for marketers and content creators who need to produce engaging, conversion-focused content at scale.</span></p><p><b><span style="font-family: Coda;">Key Features:</span></b></p><p></p><ul style="text-align: left;"><li><span style="font-family: Coda;">Advanced marketing copy generation</span></li><li><span style="font-family: Coda;">Multiple content type templates</span></li><li><span style="font-family: Coda;">Brand voice customization</span></li><li><span style="font-family: Coda;">Multilingual support</span></li><li><span style="font-family: Coda;">A/B testing variations</span></li></ul><p></p><p><b><span style="font-family: Coda;">Pricing:</span></b></p><p></p><ul style="text-align: left;"><li><span style="font-family: Coda;">Free tier available</span></li><li><span style="font-family: Coda;">Pro: $49/month</span></li><li><span style="font-family: Coda;">Advanced: $249/month</span></li><li><span style="font-family: Coda;">Enterprise: Custom pricing</span></li></ul><p></p><p><span style="font-family: Coda;"><b>Perfect For: </b>Marketing teams, copywriters, and businesses needing high-converting marketing copy across multiple channels.</span></p><h2 style="text-align: left;"><span style="font-family: Coda;">Conclusion</span></h2><p><span style="font-family: Coda;">The AI tools listed here are revolutionizing the content creation landscape in 2025, making it easier than ever to produce high-quality, engaging, and impactful content. By integrating these tools into your workflow, you can save time, unleash your creativity, and achieve better results.</span></p><p><span style="font-family: Coda;">AI doesn't replace creativity; it amplifies it. As a content creator, your unique voice and vision are irreplaceable. These tools serve as enablers, helping you focus on what you do best—creating. Explore, experiment, and innovate. The future of content creation is here, and it's brimming with possibilities.</span></p><p><span style="font-family: Coda;">Embrace these technologies, stay ahead of the curve, and watch your creative potential soar.
