</script> <script type="text/javascript" src="https://upholdbrilliancerecast.com/f9e40eb3b3cd05f1038aac7b36b33ad2/invoke.js"></script> </div> </div> </article> <article class="article-card" id="artikel-9669"> <h2>#9669. 6 Best American Tex-Mex Chains, According To Customer Reviews</h2> <div class="article-body"> <div style="text-align:center; margin-bottom:20px;"><img src="https://www.foodrepublic.com/img/gallery/6-best-american-tex-mex-chains-according-to-customer-reviews/l-intro-1794946519.jpg" alt="6 Best American Tex-Mex Chains, According To Customer Reviews" style="max-width:100%; height:auto; border-radius:8px;" loading="lazy"></div> <div style="text-align:center; margin:20px 0;"> <script type="text/javascript"> atOptions = {'key' : 'f9e40eb3b3cd05f1038aac7b36b33ad2','format' : 'iframe','height' : 90,'width' : 728,'params' : {}}; </script> <script type="text/javascript" src="https://upholdbrilliancerecast.com/f9e40eb3b3cd05f1038aac7b36b33ad2/invoke.js"></script> </div> <div class="article-body" style="font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8; color: #333;"> <p>Tex-Mex food is incredibly popular across the country, but the line between it and more traditional Mexican fare can be a bit hard to define. Plus, there are other offshoots, like California or New Mexican styles that overlap with Tex-Mex but use different ingredients, such as avocados or hatch chiles. To cut down on some of the confusion, we've created this list to help you find the most reliable, tasty, and distinctly Tex-Mex quick service and casual restaurant chains you can dine at, according to the people who eat at them.</p> <p>Derived from Mexican and Tejano cooking methods, Tex-Mex was born out of a meeting of cultures that combined time-honored techniques and new ingredients. For instance, cumin and dried chili powder had recently become available, and they quickly caught on in Tex-Mex cooking. Now the pungent, earthy spices are heavily relied on for chili and stews.</p> <p>Flour tortillas and dairy, like cheddar and Colby jack cheeses, are also big parts of the Tex-Mex food culture, as are queso dips and customizable combinations of rice, beans, proteins, and cheeses in a personal-sized bowl. Or you could just put all those elements together in an oversized burrito. Many of the restaurants on this list do just that, and all of them have been highly rated by fans for taste, price, and overall value. So, the next time you're craving fajitas, quesadillas, and refried beans, feel free to give one of these chains a visit to fulfill that hunger.</p> <p>Founded in 1991, Mi Cocina is a beloved local chain with just over 20 locations throughout Texas, but the eatery's reputation stretches far further. The upscale Tex-Mex restaurant is just as known for its cocktails, especially the swirled Mambo Taxi Margarita, as it is for the food, such as the fajitas. The upscale brand's dishes include nachos al carbon, poblano chicken enchiladas, and pork picoso tamales that are so flavorful, you definitely won't want to put ketchup on them.</p> <p>Customers rate the restaurant highly on user review platforms, with diners on Yelp saying things like, "Always consistently excellent! My go-to is the brisket tacos and a Dilemma Margarita!" Other guests agree, saying they always enjoy the food when they visit the chain. That reliability is one reason people are so quick to recommend the establishment. Even those who are quite particular about their Tex-Mex fall in love with the place, and many say they'll be back after their first time dining here.</p> <p>Don't make the mistake of confusing Taco Cabana with Taco Bell. Both chains sell tacos, but the smaller restaurant still has a homemade feel, unlike the larger, Tex-Mex fast food super-seller. That's probably because Taco Cabana still makes its from-scratch food from fresh ingredients every day. The differences in flavor and feel in the restaurant's dishes are easy to identify, especially in the handmade flour tortillas. That helps ensure you'll never have to worry about one of the most important elements of a satisfying burrito. And the ones here come overstuffed and covered in optional cheese sauce.</p> <p>Diners here develop a passion for the chain, or as one TikTok commenter declared, "Taco Cabana is my FAVORITE fast food place. It beats Taco Bell hands down." It's not hard to see why someone might feel that way. Fans enjoy the restaurant's large portions, noting that nachos come in a box large enough to be mistaken for a pizza.</p> <p>The meats get their share of the limelight too, with customers recommending items like the beef and chicken fajita nachos, and the customizable protein bowl. One of the brand's latest hit items is the bean and cheese pie, a handheld psuedo-empanada filled with refried beans and yellow cheeses.</p> <p>Uncle Julio's is an eatery that has understood the importance of making every dish from scratch since it opened several decades ago, and that includes the flour tortillas. The freshly made flatbread definitely tastes better than store-bought ones, which is why people can buy them by the dozen. And that's just one of the things that's made with care here. Dishes like guacamole that's made tableside and large burritos have led this Texas-based chain to expand into more than 30 locations.</p> <p>People appreciate the restaurant's salsa, which holds a great middle-ground between mild and spicy, and praise the bacon-wrapped shrimp, which pairs juicy, seasoned seafood with crispy and chewy slices of pork. Others say they often have enough of their meal left to take some home, especially with dishes like the chicken and steak fajitas or the Tex-Mex combination dinner.</p> <p>This Tex-Mex establishment also has a unique dessert – interactive chocolate piñatas. Guests are encouraged to play with their food when the hanging ball of decorated chocolate is brought to the table. A few short taps later and the dessert cracks open to spill strawberries, churros, and other fruits onto the tray. It's another delicious and memorable way Uncle Julio's has found to fuse cultures before ending the evening.</p> <p>Like several of the chains on this list, Fuzzy's Taco Shop was founded in Texas. But this one has gone on to become one of the largest of the homegrown brands, with more than 100 locations in 14 states. That growth was spurred forward by customers who enjoy the restaurant's sizable portions, flavors, and consistency on dishes ranging from breakfast burritos, quesadillas, nachos, and customizable bowls.</p> <p>First-time diners are impressed by the guacamole and overall experience of eating at Fuzzy's, and say they'll no doubt be returning soon. Others make it a point to visit the chain often, saying it's a great spot for birria tacos. In fact, one fan on Facebook called the dish "top notch," adding that the meal was perfectly made. Items like the grilled steak bowl and seasoned chips are so tasty they can even help people who normally eat at other Mexican-inspired places make the switch to Fuzzy's.</p> <p>Guests are warmly greeted every time they walk through the doors at Moe's Southwest Grill, a tradition the business started at the first location in 2000. Since then, the company has grown rapidly, now operating almost 550 stores across the nation. The brand is known for innovative flavors and good quality, and customers praise the queso, overstuffed burritos, and customizable bowls, which many say are better than other national brands.</p> <p>A TikTok user posted about their experience getting a nearly full bag of chips after ordering his mains, and that kind of generosity isn't rare at the chain. Another fan noted how stuffed the birria stack they ordered was, saying it was heavy to pick up, while a first-time diner was impressed by how large the bowl they ordered was.</p> <p>Fans of Moe's have plenty of choices to customize their bowls and other meals with, but many find their favorite items and stick with them. That loyalty had one customer declaring a half-hour drive to the nearest store wasn't too far to go for the food, showing that not even a little distance can keep people away when a queso craving strikes.  Or, as one Tripadvisor reviewer said, "... food is splendid! All around just great establishment. We loved everything, especially the queso!!"</p> <p>The name Qdoba Mexican Eats might catch your attention, but it's the chain's food that keeps it. So much so that in the almost 30 years the restaurant has been open, Qdoba fans have formed a rivalry with those who prefer Chipotle, which just so happens to have also been founded in Denver in the 1990s. But Colorado residents prefer the smaller chain, with customers citing the brand's freshness, taste, and generosity with the queso keeps other national brands from comparing.</p> <p>The establishment is known for the variety of fillings it offers, including steak and chicken that's grilled in-house. In addition to burrito bowls, you can customize a bowl of layered nachos, too. And the quesadillas can have some crunch added with a cheesy exterior crust. One Facebook user was so impressed by the restaurant that they posted, "I've been 5 times, the food is always fresh and hot [...] I've tried their quesadillas and bowl and I'm absolutely blown away every time with the quality. 10/10!"</p> <p>Tex-Mex chains are popular and plentiful on the restaurant landscape, so narrowing down this list to the brands fans can't stop raving about took a bit of time. First, the criteria for how we'd be defining what makes a chain the best and what made it Tex-Mex were decided.</p> <p>If the restaurants had a focus on flour tortillas, yellow cheeses, and cumin, alongside dishes, like nachos, enchiladas, fajitas, and queso, it qualified as a Tex-Mex establishment.</p> <p>The eateries had to have more than a dozen locations and good reviews for taste, value, and consistency across multiple sources. Those platforms included social media posts and comments, message boards, user review sites, and professional reviews. The final list was compiled after each chain's specific instances of customer satisfaction were tallied.</p> <p style="margin-top: 25px;"> <a href="https://www.foodrepublic.com/2319760/best-american-tex-mex-chains-customer-reviews/" target="_blank" rel="nofollow noopener" style="color: #0d6efd; text-decoration: none; font-weight: bold;"> → Baca artikel asli </a> </p> </div> <div style="text-align:center; margin:20px 0;"> <script type="text/javascript"> atOptions = {'key' : 'f9e40eb3b3cd05f1038aac7b36b33ad2','format' : 'iframe','height' : 90,'width' : 728,'params' : {}}; </script> <script type="text/javascript" src="https://upholdbrilliancerecast.com/f9e40eb3b3cd05f1038aac7b36b33ad2/invoke.js"></script> </div> </div> </article> <article class="article-card" id="artikel-9668"> <h2>#9668. Squint</h2> <div class="article-body"> <div style="text-align:center; margin:20px 0;"> <script type="text/javascript"> atOptions = {'key' : 'f9e40eb3b3cd05f1038aac7b36b33ad2','format' : 'iframe','height' : 90,'width' : 728,'params' : {}}; </script> <script type="text/javascript" src="https://upholdbrilliancerecast.com/f9e40eb3b3cd05f1038aac7b36b33ad2/invoke.js"></script> </div> <div class="article-body" style="font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8; color: #333;"> <p><p> Explains whatever you're looking at, now on Mac </p> <p> <a href="https://www.producthunt.com/products/squint?utm_campaign=producthunt-atom-posts-feed&utm_medium=rss-feed&utm_source=producthunt-atom-posts-feed">Discussion</a> | <a href="https://www.producthunt.com/r/p/1312026?app_id=339">Link</a> </p></p> <p style="margin-top: 25px;"> <a href="https://www.producthunt.com/products/squint" target="_blank" rel="nofollow noopener" style="color: #0d6efd; text-decoration: none; font-weight: bold;"> → Baca artikel asli </a> </p> </div> <div style="text-align:center; margin:20px 0;"> <script type="text/javascript"> atOptions = {'key' : 'f9e40eb3b3cd05f1038aac7b36b33ad2','format' : 'iframe','height' : 90,'width' : 728,'params' : {}}; </script> <script type="text/javascript" src="https://upholdbrilliancerecast.com/f9e40eb3b3cd05f1038aac7b36b33ad2/invoke.js"></script> </div> </div> </article> <article class="article-card" id="artikel-9667"> <h2>#9667. 19 non-traditional Thanksgiving desserts that aren't pie : Cakes, cookies, and even a tiramisu for your holiday dessert table.</h2> <div class="article-body"> <div style="text-align:center; margin-bottom:20px;"><img src="https://www.kingarthurbaking.com/sites/default/files/2026-07/Apple-Crumb-Cake_BOTW_2026_Macro_H_18465.jpg" alt="19 non-traditional Thanksgiving desserts that aren't pie : Cakes, cookies, and even a tiramisu for your holiday dessert table." style="max-width:100%; height:auto; border-radius:8px;" loading="lazy"></div> <div style="text-align:center; margin:20px 0;"> <script type="text/javascript"> atOptions = {'key' : 'f9e40eb3b3cd05f1038aac7b36b33ad2','format' : 'iframe','height' : 90,'width' : 728,'params' : {}}; </script> <script type="text/javascript" src="https://upholdbrilliancerecast.com/f9e40eb3b3cd05f1038aac7b36b33ad2/invoke.js"></script> </div> <div class="article-body" style="font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8; color: #333;"> <p>Yes, Thanksgiving is a pie-centric holiday. But what if you don’t like pie? Or maybe you just don’t want it. Either way, we’ve got lots of non-pie Thanksgiving desserts, from spiced pumpkin cupcakes to sugary apple cobblers, plus plenty of autumnal cakes.</p> <p>This adorable cake pulls double duty, serving as both a scene-stealing centerpiece and a feast-ending dessert. To make, stack two mini Bundt cakes together and frost with orange buttercream. Carving this frosted pumpkin at the end of the meal may just upstage the turkey!</p> <p>Get the recipe: The Great Pumpkin Bundt Cake</p> <p>To make this recipe, you’ll need: Mini Bundt Pan Set</p> <p>This dessert demonstrates how to dress up a crumb cake for fall: Top velvety sour cream cake with a juicy layer of apples, then crown the cake with a generous layer of apple pie-spiced streusel.</p> <p>To make this recipe, you'll need: Instant Clearjel</p> <p>Cranberry sauce can be a polarizing side dish, but everyone will love this New England-inspired cake, which pairs tart cranberries with walnuts and vanilla for a simple, satisfying dessert. (Because it’s so quick to make, this is a particularly good recipe for any last-minute holiday baking.)</p> <p>To make this recipe, you’ll need: Sparkling Sugar</p> <p>Sweet potatoes belong on the dessert table, and this recipe proves it. This ultra-soft cake is gently spiced and glows orange from the sweet potato purée, and it’s finished with a fluffy meringue that mimics marshmallow-topped sweet potato casseroles.</p> <p>Get the recipe: Sweet Potato Sheet Cake with Marshmallow Frosting (make it gluten-free with Measure for Measure Flour)</p> <p>To make this recipe, you’ll need: 9” x 13” pan</p> <p>For a dessert that’s rich but not too sweet, turn to this recipe, which pairs pumpkin and pumpkin spice with chocolate chips. Baked in a decorative Bundt pan, it can be served unfrosted for an easy-yet-elegant dessert.</p> <p>Get the recipe: Pumpkin-Chocolate Chip Cake</p> <p>To make this recipe, you’ll need: Soft Swirl Bundt Pan</p> <p>Instead of apple pie, try an apple pan dowdy on your Thanksgiving dessert table. The pan dowdy is a traditional American dish from the 1800s and early 1900s. A combination of pie and pudding, the name comes from the method in which the recipe is completed: After an apple-based filling is baked in a crust-lined casserole, the baker takes a fork and "dowdies" the crust, breaking it into pieces that remain crisp despite being partially immersed in the juicy filling.</p> <p>To make this recipe, you’ll need: 9" square pan</p> <p>“Thanksgiving cheesecake” may not have quite the same ring as “Thanksgiving pie,” but when your guests are eating this ultra-creamy dessert, they won’t care. With its burnished top and custardy interior, this Pumpkin Basque Cheesecake reimagines the classic with bold autumnal flair, thanks to golden pumpkin purée and warm spices.</p> <p>Get the recipe: Pumpkin Basque Cheesecake</p> <p>To make this recipe, you’ll need: Pumpkin Pie Spice</p> <p>Don’t be fooled by its stodgy name or humble appearance: This cake is so good, we named it our #1 best fall recipe! In fact, my colleague Jessica Battilana made it for Thanksgiving last year and declared it the biggest hit of the day; her guests fell in love with the moist, apple-loaded cake and fudgy brown sugar frosting.</p> <p>Get the recipe: Old-Fashioned Apple Cake with Brown Sugar Frosting</p> <p>To make this recipe, you’ll need: Vermont Boiled Cider</p> <p>If your biggest complaint about PSLs is that there's not enough coffee flavor, look to this Bundt cake, which has an espresso powder swirl running through the tender pumpkin crumb and a coffee glaze to finish the whole thing off.</p> <p>Get the recipe: Pumpkin Espresso Bundt Cake</p> <p>To make this recipe, you'll need: Golden Wheat Flour</p> <p>If you don’t want to fuss with pie, we suggest making a cobbler instead. This fruit-filled version pairs juicy spiced apples with a crackly brown sugar crust — both prep and serving are easy, and the resulting cobbler will absolutely steal the show.</p> <p>Get the recipe: Sugar-Crusted Apple Cobbler</p> <p>To make this recipe, you’ll need: Vietnamese Cinnamon</p> <p>Apples are great, but seasonal pears deserve some love too. This simple cake, made with a combination of almond and all-purpose flours, has a rich, buttery texture and an almost marzipan-like chew. Studded with fragrant cubes of ripe pear, it's an elegant after-dinner dessert.</p> <p>To make this recipe, you’ll need: Almond Flour</p> <p>The boozy Bundt cake features potent maple flavor thanks to the 1/2 cup (!) of maple syrup in the batter, plus the sticky maple-and-rum glaze to finish. Made with cake flour and sour cream, the cake itself is dense and velvety, like all great pound cakes should be.</p> <p>Get the recipe: Maple Pound Cake with Maple-Rum Glaze</p> <p>To make this recipe, you’ll need: Vermont Maple Syrup and Natural Maple Flavor</p> <p>Instead of slicing and serving dessert, bake every guest their own individual mini cake. Start with a moist, spicy sheet cake, then use a biscuit cutter or overturned glass to cut rounds for individual layer cakes sandwiched with cream cheese frosting.</p> <p>To make this recipe, you’ll need: Apple Pie Spice</p> <p>Rich, silky, and balanced, this cheesecake is the kind of dessert that wins people (even cheesecake skeptics) over at first bite. Pecans are blended into the crust to add a subtle nutty flavor and delicate crunch. The ultra-creamy filling gets its sweetness from brown sugar and maple syrup, while heavy cream gives it an especially luxurious texture.</p> <p>To make this recipe, you’ll need: Maple Syrup</p> <p>To make this recipe, you’ll need: Pumpkin Pie Spice</p> <p>For a little French flair at your Thanksgiving table, make this classic tarte tatin. This dessert can be a little fussy, but we’ve endlessly tested our version to make sure it goes off without a hitch in your kitchen. And it’s worth it for the deeply caramelized apples layered over shattering pastry.</p> <p>Get the recipe: Classic Apple Tarte Tatin</p> <p>To make this recipe, you’ll need: 9” round cake pan</p> <p>Tiramisu gets a fall-forward spin in this coffeeshop-inspired dessert. Just like a caramel macchiato combines espresso, steamed milk, and a generous caramel drizzle, this twist on classic tiramisu layers salted caramel sauce between espresso-soaked ladyfingers and mascarpone filling.</p> <p>Get the recipe: Caramel Macchiato Tiramisu</p> <p>To make this recipe, you’ll need: Espresso Powder</p> <p>Make serving Thanksgiving dessert a breeze by baking up a big batch of cupcakes. These are packed with pumpkin flavor and spice, then finished with an easy swoop of cream cheese frosting. If you really want to level up your presentation, check out these cupcake decorating techniques for a pro-level finish.</p> <p>Get the recipe: Pumpkin Cupcakes (make them gluten-free with Measure for Measure Flour)</p> <p>To make this recipe, you’ll need: Unbleached Cake Flour</p> <p>This holiday-ready version of our five-star Everyday Olive Oil Cake is adorned with a big red bow in the form of a simple but stunning cranberry glaze. Made by cooking cranberries with orange juice, then whisking the mixture with confectioners’ sugar, the icing adds a bright tartness that complements the rich cake.</p> <p>Get the recipe: Cranberry-Orange Olive Oil Cake</p> <p>To make this recipe, you’ll need: King Arthur Square Pan</p> <p>Find everything you need for a successful holiday meal in our Thanksgiving Survival Guide.</p> <p>Cover photo by Patrick Marinello; food styling by Yekaterina Boytsova.</p> <p>Transform your favorite bread loaf into shareable rolls.</p> <p>Top tips from the Things Bakers Know podcast.</p> <p>See our complete collection of Recipes posts.</p> <p>Desserts that may just upstage the feast.</p> <p>Because dinner rolls are a non-negotiable side dish.</p> <p>Facebook TikTok Instagram Threads Pinterest LinkedIn YouTube Reddit Substack</p> <p style="margin-top: 25px;"> <a href="https://www.kingarthurbaking.com/blog/2026/10/02/non-traditional-thanksgiving-desserts" target="_blank" rel="nofollow noopener" style="color: #0d6efd; text-decoration: none; font-weight: bold;"> → Baca artikel asli </a> </p> </div> <div style="text-align:center; margin:20px 0;"> <script type="text/javascript"> atOptions = {'key' : 'f9e40eb3b3cd05f1038aac7b36b33ad2','format' : 'iframe','height' : 90,'width' : 728,'params' : {}}; </script> <script type="text/javascript" src="https://upholdbrilliancerecast.com/f9e40eb3b3cd05f1038aac7b36b33ad2/invoke.js"></script> </div> </div> </article> <article class="article-card" id="artikel-9666"> <h2>#9666. Politics Takes A Toll On Your Health — What Do Less-Stressed People Do Differently? (M)</h2> <div class="article-body"> <div style="text-align:center; margin-bottom:20px;"><img src="https://www.spring.org.uk/images/vote-2.jpg" alt="Politics Takes A Toll On Your Health — What Do Less-Stressed People Do Differently? (M)" style="max-width:100%; height:auto; border-radius:8px;" loading="lazy"></div> <div style="text-align:center; margin:20px 0;"> <script type="text/javascript"> atOptions = {'key' : 'f9e40eb3b3cd05f1038aac7b36b33ad2','format' : 'iframe','height' : 90,'width' : 728,'params' : {}}; </script> <script type="text/javascript" src="https://upholdbrilliancerecast.com/f9e40eb3b3cd05f1038aac7b36b33ad2/invoke.js"></script> </div> <div class="article-body" style="font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8; color: #333;"> <p>Following politics need not mean constant distress: a study points to a possible role for noticing and trusting bodily signals.</p> <p>Following politics need not mean constant distress: a study points to a possible role for noticing and trusting bodily signals.</p> <p>• Read members-only articles • Adverts removed • Cancel at any time • 14 day money-back guarantee for new members</p> <p>Psychologist, Jeremy Dean, PhD is the founder and author of PsyBlog. He holds a doctorate in psychology from University College London and two other advanced degrees in psychology. He has been writing about scientific research on PsyBlog since 2004. View all posts by Dr Jeremy Dean</p> <p style="margin-top: 25px;"> <a href="https://www.spring.org.uk/2026/11/politics-stress.php" target="_blank" rel="nofollow noopener" style="color: #0d6efd; text-decoration: none; font-weight: bold;"> → Baca artikel asli </a> </p> </div> <div style="text-align:center; margin:20px 0;"> <script type="text/javascript"> atOptions = {'key' : 'f9e40eb3b3cd05f1038aac7b36b33ad2','format' : 'iframe','height' : 90,'width' : 728,'params' : {}}; </script> <script type="text/javascript" src="https://upholdbrilliancerecast.com/f9e40eb3b3cd05f1038aac7b36b33ad2/invoke.js"></script> </div> </div> </article> <article class="article-card" id="artikel-9665"> <h2>#9665. Add This Ingredient To French Toast For A Crispier Crust (Hint: It's Not Butter Or Oil)</h2> <div class="article-body"> <div style="text-align:center; margin-bottom:20px;"><img src="https://www.foodrepublic.com/img/gallery/add-this-ingredient-to-french-toast-for-a-crispier-crust-hint-its-not-butter-or-oil/l-intro-1794821014.jpg" alt="Add This Ingredient To French Toast For A Crispier Crust (Hint: It's Not Butter Or Oil)" style="max-width:100%; height:auto; border-radius:8px;" loading="lazy"></div> <div style="text-align:center; margin:20px 0;"> <script type="text/javascript"> atOptions = {'key' : 'f9e40eb3b3cd05f1038aac7b36b33ad2','format' : 'iframe','height' : 90,'width' : 728,'params' : {}}; </script> <script type="text/javascript" src="https://upholdbrilliancerecast.com/f9e40eb3b3cd05f1038aac7b36b33ad2/invoke.js"></script> </div> <div class="article-body" style="font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8; color: #333;"> <p>A classic French toast recipe is one of those comforting dishes that can be whipped up in a matter of minutes. However, one common problem people run into is soggy bread rather than a crisp, beautifully caramelized exterior. Unfortunately, sogginess is something of an occupational hazard when you're soaking bread in liquid. To give your slices more of a chance to thrive, all you need to do is add a little semolina flour to your soaking mixture. Two tablespoons per cup and a half of liquid is just about all you need.</p> <p>Semolina is a coarse, pale-yellow flour made by grinding the endosperm of durum wheat, one of the hardest species of wheat there is. Compared to standard, powdery all-purpose flour, semolina is higher in protein and fiber, and its coarse grains are well-suited to soaking up moisture. In French toast, that can be the difference between a soggy exterior and a crispy one. A small amount turns a watery custard into a more structured batter that clings to the bread instead of letting it drink up all that liquid and fall apart before it even reaches the frying pan. Its subtle nuttiness also adds a whole new layer of complexity to the flavor of the French toast, and would pair wonderfully with some cosy nutmeg and cinnamon.</p> <p>Just don't go overboard. Semolina is still flour, so balance is key. Add too little and the mixture stays watery; add too much, and you end up with something closer to a paste than a batter. We recommend starting with a small amount, around a tablespoon, then adjusting until you reach your desired consistency. Semolina flour takes time to absorb liquid, so once you've added it, let the custard sit for a minimum of 10 minutes before adding your bread. Once it's rested, it should be thick enough to coat the back of a spoon.</p> <p>Semolina is one way to give French toast a crispy, lightly browned exterior, but it's by no means the only one. If you're having a hard time finding it, you can always swap in regular flour. The texture is different, but flour also absorbs liquid and thickens the batter, so you get largely the same effect, just without the nutty flavor. You could even skip the flour altogether and stir a cornstarch slurry into the custard, which packs even more thickening power. Just remember, as with semolina, moderation is key when adding flour or cornstarch into the mix.</p> <p>Beyond thickening the custard, there are plenty of other handy tricks for shatteringly crispy French toast. To improve both its texture and flavor, give your bread a generous dusting of sugar after it comes out of the custard (before it hits the heat). Alton Brown might prefer honey over sugar in his French toast, but we'd argue that's a rare mistake. See, once sugar hits the heat, it starts to caramelize, melting into a crisp, brûléed crust and infusing the bread with a rich, toasty flavor. Keep the heat moderate, since caramelization can quickly turn to burning without proper care.</p> <p>If you're not sold on the idea of messing around with the batter or adding extra ingredients, you can guarantee crispy French toast from the get-go by using stale bread. This might not sound too appetizing, but hear us out. Bread that's around one to two days old has lost a good chunk of its moisture, which leaves it firmer and drier. It acts like a sponge, soaking up the custard without turning to mush, so you get a rich, eggy center and a browned exterior instead of a soggy, limp slice.</p> <p style="margin-top: 25px;"> <a href="https://www.foodrepublic.com/2317376/add-ingredient-french-toast-cripsier-crust-semolina-flour-not-butter/" target="_blank" rel="nofollow noopener" style="color: #0d6efd; text-decoration: none; font-weight: bold;"> → Baca artikel asli </a> </p> </div> <div style="text-align:center; margin:20px 0;"> <script type="text/javascript"> atOptions = {'key' : 'f9e40eb3b3cd05f1038aac7b36b33ad2','format' : 'iframe','height' : 90,'width' : 728,'params' : {}}; </script> <script type="text/javascript" src="https://upholdbrilliancerecast.com/f9e40eb3b3cd05f1038aac7b36b33ad2/invoke.js"></script> </div> </div> </article> <article class="article-card" id="artikel-9664"> <h2>#9664. Leapdeck</h2> <div class="article-body"> <div style="text-align:center; margin:20px 0;"> <script type="text/javascript"> atOptions = {'key' : 'f9e40eb3b3cd05f1038aac7b36b33ad2','format' : 'iframe','height' : 90,'width' : 728,'params' : {}}; </script> <script type="text/javascript" src="https://upholdbrilliancerecast.com/f9e40eb3b3cd05f1038aac7b36b33ad2/invoke.js"></script> </div> <div class="article-body" style="font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8; color: #333;"> <p><p> Leap to any Mac Space from a key or your iPhone </p> <p> <a href="https://www.producthunt.com/products/leapdeck?utm_campaign=producthunt-atom-posts-feed&utm_medium=rss-feed&utm_source=producthunt-atom-posts-feed">Discussion</a> | <a href="https://www.producthunt.com/r/p/1318840?app_id=339">Link</a> </p></p> <p style="margin-top: 25px;"> <a href="https://www.producthunt.com/products/leapdeck" target="_blank" rel="nofollow noopener" style="color: #0d6efd; text-decoration: none; font-weight: bold;"> → Baca artikel asli </a> </p> </div> <div style="text-align:center; margin:20px 0;"> <script type="text/javascript"> atOptions = {'key' : 'f9e40eb3b3cd05f1038aac7b36b33ad2','format' : 'iframe','height' : 90,'width' : 728,'params' : {}}; </script> <script type="text/javascript" src="https://upholdbrilliancerecast.com/f9e40eb3b3cd05f1038aac7b36b33ad2/invoke.js"></script> </div> </div> </article> <article class="article-card" id="artikel-9663"> <h2>#9663. Resurf</h2> <div class="article-body"> <div style="text-align:center; margin:20px 0;"> <script type="text/javascript"> atOptions = {'key' : 'f9e40eb3b3cd05f1038aac7b36b33ad2','format' : 'iframe','height' : 90,'width' : 728,'params' : {}}; </script> <script type="text/javascript" src="https://upholdbrilliancerecast.com/f9e40eb3b3cd05f1038aac7b36b33ad2/invoke.js"></script> </div> <div class="article-body" style="font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8; color: #333;"> <p><p> Personal Knowledge Base & Bookmark Manager for Mac </p> <p> <a href="https://www.producthunt.com/products/resurf-2?utm_campaign=producthunt-atom-posts-feed&utm_medium=rss-feed&utm_source=producthunt-atom-posts-feed">Discussion</a> | <a href="https://www.producthunt.com/r/p/1325452?app_id=339">Link</a> </p></p> <p style="margin-top: 25px;"> <a href="https://www.producthunt.com/products/resurf-2" target="_blank" rel="nofollow noopener" style="color: #0d6efd; text-decoration: none; font-weight: bold;"> → Baca artikel asli </a> </p> </div> <div style="text-align:center; margin:20px 0;"> <script type="text/javascript"> atOptions = {'key' : 'f9e40eb3b3cd05f1038aac7b36b33ad2','format' : 'iframe','height' : 90,'width' : 728,'params' : {}}; </script> <script type="text/javascript" src="https://upholdbrilliancerecast.com/f9e40eb3b3cd05f1038aac7b36b33ad2/invoke.js"></script> </div> </div> </article> <article class="article-card" id="artikel-9662"> <h2>#9662. Not Spices Or Herbs: Add This Aromatic Ingredient To Canned Chili For Double The Flavor</h2> <div class="article-body"> <div style="text-align:center; margin-bottom:20px;"><img src="https://www.foodrepublic.com/img/gallery/not-spices-or-herbs-add-this-aromatic-ingredient-to-canned-chili-for-double-the-flavor/l-intro-1794597069.jpg" alt="Not Spices Or Herbs: Add This Aromatic Ingredient To Canned Chili For Double The Flavor" style="max-width:100%; height:auto; border-radius:8px;" loading="lazy"></div> <div style="text-align:center; margin:20px 0;"> <script type="text/javascript"> atOptions = {'key' : 'f9e40eb3b3cd05f1038aac7b36b33ad2','format' : 'iframe','height' : 90,'width' : 728,'params' : {}}; </script> <script type="text/javascript" src="https://upholdbrilliancerecast.com/f9e40eb3b3cd05f1038aac7b36b33ad2/invoke.js"></script> </div> <div class="article-body" style="font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8; color: #333;"> <p>We may receive a commission on purchases made from links.</p> <p>Chili is one of those meals that scratches an itch that no other comfort food can quite compare to. You can go with beans or no beans, or even make a super satisfying vegan version. A big batch can be pretty easy to make in the slow cooker, but despite the simple prep, it still takes a lot of time. So, when you want a quick hit, you can always reach for your favorite brand of the canned stuff. However, there's an easy trick to up the flavor of your meal — add a dash of instant coffee. The incredible blend of flavors might just blow your mind.</p> <p>Instant coffee crystals will add some bold, roasted richness to your chili. Sure, coffee is bitter, but if you don't go overboard, its presence will be subtle, making your chili taste more like something homemade that's been simmering on the stove all day. It creates a nice depth by enhancing the perception of the beefy umami and highlighting spices like cumin, coriander, cayenne, and chili powder. It can also help offset some of the perceived acidity in the tomato-heavy sauce, giving you an end result that's more balanced on the palate and beautifully tied together.</p> <p>If you don't already have instant coffee in the pantry, instant espresso, like Medaglia D'Oro Instant Espresso, is sometimes preferred because it dissolves more easily, but really, any instant coffee will work. Just keep in mind that espresso will have a stronger flavor, and the strength of any given coffee crystals can vary a bit. Start with just a pinch, or about a ¼ teaspoon per 15-ounce can of chili. You can dissolve it in a few spoonfuls of hot water first to ensure it doesn't clump, but if the chili is already simmering, it should blend in easily, especially in small amounts. Give it a taste and add more if you'd like.</p> <p>If you want to go for bolder undertones, a touch of cocoa powder pairs nicely with coffee crystals. If you want to skip the instant coffee and use the real thing, you can add a little brewed coffee or finely ground espresso (but when using the latter, you'll need to mix it into a paste with some water so you don't end up with a mouthful of grounds). A splash of bourbon, or even beer, can help round out the flavor with the coffee. And much like it works in chili, instant coffee can wake up your spaghetti sauce. But to get that great earthy, bold flavor in a full meal right off the shelf, you're going to want to try coffee crystals in your canned chili.</p> <p style="margin-top: 25px;"> <a href="https://www.foodrepublic.com/2316380/not-spices-herbs-add-aromatic-ingredient-canned-chili-double-flavor-instant-coffee/" target="_blank" rel="nofollow noopener" style="color: #0d6efd; text-decoration: none; font-weight: bold;"> → Baca artikel asli </a> </p> </div> <div style="text-align:center; margin:20px 0;"> <script type="text/javascript"> atOptions = {'key' : 'f9e40eb3b3cd05f1038aac7b36b33ad2','format' : 'iframe','height' : 90,'width' : 728,'params' : {}}; </script> <script type="text/javascript" src="https://upholdbrilliancerecast.com/f9e40eb3b3cd05f1038aac7b36b33ad2/invoke.js"></script> </div> </div> </article> <article class="article-card" id="artikel-9661"> <h2>#9661. Wispim</h2> <div class="article-body"> <div style="text-align:center; margin:20px 0;"> <script type="text/javascript"> atOptions = {'key' : 'f9e40eb3b3cd05f1038aac7b36b33ad2','format' : 'iframe','height' : 90,'width' : 728,'params' : {}}; </script> <script type="text/javascript" src="https://upholdbrilliancerecast.com/f9e40eb3b3cd05f1038aac7b36b33ad2/invoke.js"></script> </div> <div class="article-body" style="font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8; color: #333;"> <p><p> The teleprompter that follows your voice </p> <p> <a href="https://www.producthunt.com/products/wispim-online-teleprompter?utm_campaign=producthunt-atom-posts-feed&utm_medium=rss-feed&utm_source=producthunt-atom-posts-feed">Discussion</a> | <a href="https://www.producthunt.com/r/p/1305689?app_id=339">Link</a> </p></p> <p style="margin-top: 25px;"> <a href="https://www.producthunt.com/products/wispim-online-teleprompter" target="_blank" rel="nofollow noopener" style="color: #0d6efd; text-decoration: none; font-weight: bold;"> → Baca artikel asli </a> </p> </div> <div style="text-align:center; margin:20px 0;"> <script type="text/javascript"> atOptions = {'key' : 'f9e40eb3b3cd05f1038aac7b36b33ad2','format' : 'iframe','height' : 90,'width' : 728,'params' : {}}; </script> <script type="text/javascript" src="https://upholdbrilliancerecast.com/f9e40eb3b3cd05f1038aac7b36b33ad2/invoke.js"></script> </div> </div> </article> <article class="article-card" id="artikel-9660"> <h2>#9660. Give Tuna Salad A Major Flavor Boost With One Sharp, Creamy Ingredient</h2> <div class="article-body"> <div style="text-align:center; margin-bottom:20px;"><img src="https://www.foodrepublic.com/img/gallery/give-tuna-salad-a-major-flavor-boost-with-one-sharp-creamy-ingredient/l-intro-1794842011.jpg" alt="Give Tuna Salad A Major Flavor Boost With One Sharp, Creamy Ingredient" style="max-width:100%; height:auto; border-radius:8px;" loading="lazy"></div> <div style="text-align:center; margin:20px 0;"> <script type="text/javascript"> atOptions = {'key' : 'f9e40eb3b3cd05f1038aac7b36b33ad2','format' : 'iframe','height' : 90,'width' : 728,'params' : {}}; </script> <script type="text/javascript" src="https://upholdbrilliancerecast.com/f9e40eb3b3cd05f1038aac7b36b33ad2/invoke.js"></script> </div> <div class="article-body" style="font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8; color: #333;"> <p>At first glance, tuna salad may appear to be a fairly set-in-stone formula. You mix the tinned fish with mayo, add in some aromatics, and enjoy the dish on bread or standalone. Yet start trialing creative add-ins, and tuna salad welcomes a surprisingly wide array of ingredients. There are so many ways to take plain tuna salad to the next level. A sharp cheddar cheese is one unexpected flavor boost.</p> <p>After all, creaminess is a central part of the dish's appeal. And as a dairy product, cheddar cheese offers such a smooth mouthfeel in spades. However, unlike a simple mayo dressing, the cheese comes with a punch. Aging develops complex flavors, which can vary from barely perceptible tartness to rich nuttiness to a bold bite. Usually, the older the cheddar, the more amplified the flavor — although as the cheese develops, it loses some creaminess to become crumbly.</p> <p>For a top-tier cheddar tuna salad, go with a balanced option, aged for around six to nine months. Usually classified specifically as sharp, such a cheese is right when the acidic flavors turn into a bold bite — perfect for a tuna salad. So cube up the cheese, using two ounces per can of tuna, then stir everything up with some salt, onions, celery, and your other go-to tuna salad fold-ins. You'll get a dish that's still comforting, but also comes with revamped flair.</p> <p>As America's favorite cheese, cheddar certainly belongs in a dish like tuna salad. While it's not common to mix cheese directly into the salad, the inclusion is reminiscent of a beloved tuna salad application: a tuna melt. Originating by mistake, the tuna melt proves that fish and cheese do belong on the same plate, especially if tuna's involved.</p> <p>Further embrace the two dishes by heating the cheddar cheese tuna salad. The cheese will turn molten inside — not only on top — of the fish, making for an extra-satisfying filling. Pair that with a nice bread, say a classic American white loaf, a deli-inspired rye, or a dependable sourdough, and you've got a terrific sandwich on your hands.</p> <p>Not to say there's not more magic to explore with a cold cheddar tuna salad, too. The cheesy rendition is a befitting tuna pasta salad twist. Or balance out cheddar's richness by rolling the salad into lettuce wraps, a delicious appetizer option. Cheddar gives tuna salad that extra oomph, turning the basic dish into a centerpiece meal.</p> <p style="margin-top: 25px;"> <a href="https://www.foodrepublic.com/2317646/give-tuna-salad-flavor-boost-creamy-ingredient/" target="_blank" rel="nofollow noopener" style="color: #0d6efd; text-decoration: none; font-weight: bold;"> → Baca artikel asli </a> </p> </div> <div style="text-align:center; margin:20px 0;"> <script type="text/javascript"> atOptions = {'key' : 'f9e40eb3b3cd05f1038aac7b36b33ad2','format' : 'iframe','height' : 90,'width' : 728,'params' : {}}; </script> <script type="text/javascript" src="https://upholdbrilliancerecast.com/f9e40eb3b3cd05f1038aac7b36b33ad2/invoke.js"></script> </div> </div> </article> <article class="article-card" id="artikel-9659"> <h2>#9659. 3 Dark Personality Traits Linked To Infidelity</h2> <div class="article-body"> <div style="text-align:center; margin-bottom:20px;"><img src="https://www.spring.org.uk/images/couple9-1.jpg" alt="3 Dark Personality Traits Linked To Infidelity" style="max-width:100%; height:auto; border-radius:8px;" loading="lazy"></div> <div style="text-align:center; margin:20px 0;"> <script type="text/javascript"> atOptions = {'key' : 'f9e40eb3b3cd05f1038aac7b36b33ad2','format' : 'iframe','height' : 90,'width' : 728,'params' : {}}; </script> <script type="text/javascript" src="https://upholdbrilliancerecast.com/f9e40eb3b3cd05f1038aac7b36b33ad2/invoke.js"></script> </div> <div class="article-body" style="font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8; color: #333;"> <p>Certain personality traits may help explain why some people betray a partner’s trust.</p> <p>Certain personality traits may help explain why some people betray a partner’s trust.</p> <p>Psychopathy, manipulativeness and narcissism are all associated with cheating.</p> <p>The strongest average link is with psychopathy, closely followed by Machiavellianism.</p> <p>Narcissism, which involves an inflated sense of self-importance and a need for admiration, has the weakest link.</p> <p>Impulsivity, emotional coldness and a willingness to manipulate others may help explain why these characteristics are associated with betrayal.</p> <p>The conclusions come from a review of 11 studies examining dark personality traits and infidelity.</p> <p>Participants included university students, married couples and adults from the general population.</p> <p>All three traits were positively associated with infidelity, although the strength of the association varied between studies.</p> <p>Psychopathic traits include impulsivity, low empathy and a lack of guilt.</p> <p>Someone with these characteristics may be more drawn to immediate sexual rewards and less concerned about hurting a partner.</p> <p>A willingness to take risks could also make the possibility of being caught less of a deterrent — impulsivity and deception may help explain this link.</p> <p>Psychopathy had the largest average correlation with cheating, although its association was close to that of Machiavellianism.</p> <p>Machiavellianism involves a cynical view of others and a willingness to manipulate people for personal advantage.</p> <p>In romantic relationships, these characteristics could make deception easier to justify when it serves someone’s interests.</p> <p>However, a calculating approach may also encourage caution.</p> <p>Someone concerned with protecting their reputation might weigh the potential rewards of an affair against the consequences of discovery.</p> <p>This calculated approach could help explain Machiavellianism’s slightly weaker link with cheating.</p> <p>Narcissism involves feelings of superiority, entitlement and a strong desire for admiration.</p> <p>Attention from another potential partner may appeal to someone who places great importance on being desirable.</p> <p>Nevertheless, narcissism had the smallest average association with infidelity and produced a less consistent pattern across the reviewed studies.</p> <p>An inflated ego alone therefore offers relatively little information about whether someone has been unfaithful.</p> <p>The broader picture may depend on how personality combines with relationship satisfaction, commitment and access to alternative partners.</p> <p>Dark traits provide only part of the explanation for why people betray a partner’s trust.</p> <p>The study was published in the journal Psihologija (Ataman & Yalçınkaya Alkar, 2025).</p> <p>Psychologist, Jeremy Dean, PhD is the founder and author of PsyBlog. He holds a doctorate in psychology from University College London and two other advanced degrees in psychology. He has been writing about scientific research on PsyBlog since 2004. View all posts by Dr Jeremy Dean</p> <p>Join the free PsyBlog mailing list. No spam, ever.</p> <p style="margin-top: 25px;"> <a href="https://www.spring.org.uk/2026/11/dark-infidelity.php" target="_blank" rel="nofollow noopener" style="color: #0d6efd; text-decoration: none; font-weight: bold;"> → Baca artikel asli </a> </p> </div> <div style="text-align:center; margin:20px 0;"> <script type="text/javascript"> atOptions = {'key' : 'f9e40eb3b3cd05f1038aac7b36b33ad2','format' : 'iframe','height' : 90,'width' : 728,'params' : {}}; </script> <script type="text/javascript" src="https://upholdbrilliancerecast.com/f9e40eb3b3cd05f1038aac7b36b33ad2/invoke.js"></script> </div> </div> </article> <article class="article-card" id="artikel-9658"> <h2>#9658. This Thanksgiving, make your pies mini: Mini pies may be the secret to a stress-free celebration.</h2> <div class="article-body"> <div style="text-align:center; margin-bottom:20px;"><img src="https://www.kingarthurbaking.com/sites/default/files/2026-09/Mini-Apple-Pies_2026_Graphic_H_2990.jpg" alt="This Thanksgiving, make your pies mini: Mini pies may be the secret to a stress-free celebration." style="max-width:100%; height:auto; border-radius:8px;" loading="lazy"></div> <div style="text-align:center; margin:20px 0;"> <script type="text/javascript"> atOptions = {'key' : 'f9e40eb3b3cd05f1038aac7b36b33ad2','format' : 'iframe','height' : 90,'width' : 728,'params' : {}}; </script> <script type="text/javascript" src="https://upholdbrilliancerecast.com/f9e40eb3b3cd05f1038aac7b36b33ad2/invoke.js"></script> </div> <div class="article-body" style="font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8; color: #333;"> <p>What’s the one food you most look forward to at Thanksgiving?</p> <p>For some it’s the turkey. For others it’s the array of sides. But for many of us bakers, let’s admit it — our thoughts skip right over the apps and main meal and go straight to the pies, whether it's apple, pumpkin, pecan, or all of them together.</p> <p>The problem is that for smaller gatherings, the need for multiple pies diminishes. Still, how can you bear to choose between apple, pumpkin, and pecan?</p> <p>Enter the mini pie, a great way to showcase an array of pies and have them all disappear by the end of the day.</p> <p>Here’s a potential hosting scenario this year: You’re serving six close family members (including yourself) at Thanksgiving dinner; you want to offer pumpkin, apple, and pecan pie. So you pull out your mini muffin pan and use it to make mini pies in a variety of different flavors. Everyone can enjoy one mini pie immediately, one later, and squirrel one away for the next day.</p> <p>And mini pies aren't just handy for smaller gatherings — they can also make life a little easier during the frenetic rush of food prep in the days before Turkey Day. Helpfully, you can make these pies well ahead of Thanksgiving; they can be prepared, baked, and then frozen for up to a few weeks before serving.</p> <p>Once cool, wrap each pie individually in plastic, then bag them all airtight and freeze. When you’re ready to serve, unwrap, thaw, and reheat briefly: 5 to 10 minutes in a 350°F oven or about 20 seconds (per pie) in a microwave will bring them back to life.</p> <p>Because these mini pies have a higher crust-to-filling ratio, you don't need to prebake the crust to avoid a soggy bottom. Just place the pie dough rounds in your mini muffin pan, fill with about a tablespoon of the pumpkin custard, and bake.</p> <p>Another benefit: The smaller amount of filling makes it easier to nail the bake. You don't have to look for a perfect amount of jiggle in your pie before removing from the oven — just bake until the exposed edges are golden brown and the custard is set in the center.</p> <p>Turn to our Pecan Tassies recipe — a beloved Southern dessert, pecan tassies are basically just bite-size pecan pies. This recipe uses a tender, unsweetened cream cheese pastry, which cradles a gooey nut filling sweetened with brown sugar (no corn syrup).</p> <p>We’ve saved perhaps the most beloved pie for last: apple. These mini apple pies are a bit more involved than the pumpkin or pecan pies. You need to precook the filling, and you have to choose how to top them. That said, they’re totally worth the effort (and the filling can be prepared up to five days in advance; store the cooled filling, covered, in the refrigerator until ready to bake).</p> <p>Once you've precooked the diced apple filling on the stovetop to remove excess liquid, assemble your pies in your mini muffin pan by lining with rounds of pie dough and adding the apples. You can then choose how to top them:</p> <p>You may be questioning whether making mini Thanksgiving pies is more trouble than it's worth. But helpfully, the techniques involved are very approachable — mix, roll, fill, bake — and the resulting pies are both delicious and just plain fun. Have you ever wanted a whole Thanksgiving pie just for yourself? You can have it — in miniature. Happy baking!</p> <p>Do you say you won't dare bake pie because you're unsure of your skills with a rolling pin? Check out these other easy no-roll crusts: No-Roll Pie Crust and Graham Cracker Crust.</p> <p>Cover photo by Patrick Marinello; food styling by Kaitlin Wayne. Additional contributions from PJ Hamel.</p> <p>Transform your favorite bread loaf into shareable rolls.</p> <p>Top tips from the Things Bakers Know podcast.</p> <p>See our complete collection of Recipes posts.</p> <p>Top tips from the Things Bakers Know podcast.</p> <p>Because dinner rolls are a non-negotiable side dish.</p> <p>Facebook TikTok Instagram Threads Pinterest LinkedIn YouTube Reddit Substack</p> <p style="margin-top: 25px;"> <a href="https://www.kingarthurbaking.com/blog/2026/11/04/mini-Thanksgiving-pies" target="_blank" rel="nofollow noopener" style="color: #0d6efd; text-decoration: none; font-weight: bold;"> → Baca artikel asli </a> </p> </div> <div style="text-align:center; margin:20px 0;"> <script type="text/javascript"> atOptions = {'key' : 'f9e40eb3b3cd05f1038aac7b36b33ad2','format' : 'iframe','height' : 90,'width' : 728,'params' : {}}; </script> <script type="text/javascript" src="https://upholdbrilliancerecast.com/f9e40eb3b3cd05f1038aac7b36b33ad2/invoke.js"></script> </div> </div> </article> <article class="article-card" id="artikel-9657"> <h2>#9657. Omi CLI</h2> <div class="article-body"> <div style="text-align:center; margin:20px 0;"> <script type="text/javascript"> atOptions = {'key' : 'f9e40eb3b3cd05f1038aac7b36b33ad2','format' : 'iframe','height' : 90,'width' : 728,'params' : {}}; </script> <script type="text/javascript" src="https://upholdbrilliancerecast.com/f9e40eb3b3cd05f1038aac7b36b33ad2/invoke.js"></script> </div> <div class="article-body" style="font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8; color: #333;"> <p><p> An AI coding agent in your terminal, on 13 models </p> <p> <a href="https://www.producthunt.com/products/omi-cli?utm_campaign=producthunt-atom-posts-feed&utm_medium=rss-feed&utm_source=producthunt-atom-posts-feed">Discussion</a> | <a href="https://www.producthunt.com/r/p/1325043?app_id=339">Link</a> </p></p> <p style="margin-top: 25px;"> <a href="https://www.producthunt.com/products/omi-cli" target="_blank" rel="nofollow noopener" style="color: #0d6efd; text-decoration: none; font-weight: bold;"> → Baca artikel asli </a> </p> </div> <div style="text-align:center; margin:20px 0;"> <script type="text/javascript"> atOptions = {'key' : 'f9e40eb3b3cd05f1038aac7b36b33ad2','format' : 'iframe','height' : 90,'width' : 728,'params' : {}}; </script> <script type="text/javascript" src="https://upholdbrilliancerecast.com/f9e40eb3b3cd05f1038aac7b36b33ad2/invoke.js"></script> </div> </div> </article> <article class="article-card" id="artikel-9656"> <h2>#9656. Yoroll</h2> <div class="article-body"> <div style="text-align:center; margin:20px 0;"> <script type="text/javascript"> atOptions = {'key' : 'f9e40eb3b3cd05f1038aac7b36b33ad2','format' : 'iframe','height' : 90,'width' : 728,'params' : {}}; </script> <script type="text/javascript" src="https://upholdbrilliancerecast.com/f9e40eb3b3cd05f1038aac7b36b33ad2/invoke.js"></script> </div> <div class="article-body" style="font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8; color: #333;"> <p><p> Build playable stories without a game engine </p> <p> <a href="https://www.producthunt.com/products/yoroll?utm_campaign=producthunt-atom-posts-feed&utm_medium=rss-feed&utm_source=producthunt-atom-posts-feed">Discussion</a> | <a href="https://www.producthunt.com/r/p/1306148?app_id=339">Link</a> </p></p> <p style="margin-top: 25px;"> <a href="https://www.producthunt.com/products/yoroll" target="_blank" rel="nofollow noopener" style="color: #0d6efd; text-decoration: none; font-weight: bold;"> → Baca artikel asli </a> </p> </div> <div style="text-align:center; margin:20px 0;"> <script type="text/javascript"> atOptions = {'key' : 'f9e40eb3b3cd05f1038aac7b36b33ad2','format' : 'iframe','height' : 90,'width' : 728,'params' : {}}; </script> <script type="text/javascript" src="https://upholdbrilliancerecast.com/f9e40eb3b3cd05f1038aac7b36b33ad2/invoke.js"></script> </div> </div> </article> <article class="article-card" id="artikel-9655"> <h2>#9655. Skip The Pan: Grilled Cheese Is 10x Crispier When You Cook It Like This</h2> <div class="article-body"> <div style="text-align:center; margin-bottom:20px;"><img src="https://www.foodrepublic.com/img/gallery/skip-the-pan-grilled-cheese-is-10x-crispier-when-you-cook-it-like-this/l-intro-1794854726.jpg" alt="Skip The Pan: Grilled Cheese Is 10x Crispier When You Cook It Like This" style="max-width:100%; height:auto; border-radius:8px;" loading="lazy"></div> <div style="text-align:center; margin:20px 0;"> <script type="text/javascript"> atOptions = {'key' : 'f9e40eb3b3cd05f1038aac7b36b33ad2','format' : 'iframe','height' : 90,'width' : 728,'params' : {}}; </script> <script type="text/javascript" src="https://upholdbrilliancerecast.com/f9e40eb3b3cd05f1038aac7b36b33ad2/invoke.js"></script> </div> <div class="article-body" style="font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8; color: #333;"> <p>Whether you like it on its own or coupled with a bowl of roasted tomato soup, a grilled cheese is one of life's simple pleasures. Making one for yourself is simple enough in a pan or skillet. However, preparing half a dozen or more can be a pretty big undertaking on the stovetop. Fortunately, there's an easier way. By using a couple of baking sheets and your oven, you can conveniently whip up a large batch of these cheesy sandwiches that come out super crispy.</p> <p>This technique mimics a panini press, which functions by heating top and bottom metal plates connected by a hinge. This gets both sides of the sandwich crispy at the same time, eliminating the need for flipping. However, these presses have their downsides. The weight of the plates, for instance, can turn softer bread into a pancake. Baking sheets, on the other hand, are much lighter and won't compromise the integrity of more delicate breads.</p> <p>The oven also has the advantage of providing ambient heat since it's an enclosed environment. This means that your sandwich is getting heated on all sides instead of just the top and bottom, helping to create crisp crusts and melted cheese. However, you still need to preheat your top baking sheet for even crispness, since the bottom of your sandwiches could brown before the tops get crispy.</p> <p>Depending on how many sandwiches you want to prepare, you can vary the size of the baking sheet you use. To make about six to eight at once, use a half-sheet pan, which measures about 18 inches by 13 inches and is probably the size you have at home. You can also use a quarter-sheet pan if you want to make fewer.</p> <p>While the fat you spread on your bread (we recommend mayo for the crispiest results) will help ensure that your sandwiches don't stick to the baking sheets, you can also take a tip from Ina Garten and use parchment paper to line the pans for extra insurance. Also, don't stick to just using your baking sheets right side up. In fact, using your bottom pan upside down will allow for more airflow since the rim won't get in the way, thus crisping your sandwiches more effectively.</p> <p>To make this technique really work, though, you're going to need to make sure you choose the right kind of cheese that will melt easily by the time the crusts of your sandwiches become golden brown. After all, you don't want to have to keep putting your grilled cheeses back in the oven to finish melting. The best options have a good balance of moisture and fat, and younger cheeses tend to be the go-to varieties that meet this standard. Some recommendations include Havarti, Gruyère, and cheddar. However, you can opt for some underrated (but tasty) cheeses to give your sandwiches extra character. You can also combine several types of cheese for a more varied flavor and texture.</p> <p style="margin-top: 25px;"> <a href="https://www.foodrepublic.com/2318127/skip-pan-grilled-cheese-10x-crispier-baking-sheet-oven/" target="_blank" rel="nofollow noopener" style="color: #0d6efd; text-decoration: none; font-weight: bold;"> → Baca artikel asli </a> </p> </div> <div style="text-align:center; margin:20px 0;"> <script type="text/javascript"> atOptions = {'key' : 'f9e40eb3b3cd05f1038aac7b36b33ad2','format' : 'iframe','height' : 90,'width' : 728,'params' : {}}; </script> <script type="text/javascript" src="https://upholdbrilliancerecast.com/f9e40eb3b3cd05f1038aac7b36b33ad2/invoke.js"></script> </div> </div> </article> <article class="article-card" id="artikel-9654"> <h2>#9654. The ADHD Trait That Can Fuel Creativity — If You Know How To Channel It (M)</h2> <div class="article-body"> <div style="text-align:center; margin-bottom:20px;"><img src="https://www.spring.org.uk/images/art-1-2.jpg" alt="The ADHD Trait That Can Fuel Creativity — If You Know How To Channel It (M)" style="max-width:100%; height:auto; border-radius:8px;" loading="lazy"></div> <div style="text-align:center; margin:20px 0;"> <script type="text/javascript"> atOptions = {'key' : 'f9e40eb3b3cd05f1038aac7b36b33ad2','format' : 'iframe','height' : 90,'width' : 728,'params' : {}}; </script> <script type="text/javascript" src="https://upholdbrilliancerecast.com/f9e40eb3b3cd05f1038aac7b36b33ad2/invoke.js"></script> </div> <div class="article-body" style="font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8; color: #333;"> <p>The same broad attention that can make focus difficult may also help people with ADHD connect ideas in novel ways.</p> <p>The same broad attention that can make focus difficult may also help people with ADHD connect ideas in novel ways.</p> <p>• Read members-only articles • Adverts removed • Cancel at any time • 14 day money-back guarantee for new members</p> <p>Psychologist, Jeremy Dean, PhD is the founder and author of PsyBlog.
